reviews.text: Gary Stout at Overhead Garage Doors delivers exceptional service in every respect. From the initial call through final installation, Gary was professional, responsive, and deeply knowledgeable. He took the time to understand the situation, clearly explained options and trade-offs, and made thoughtful recommendations rather than pushing a quick sale. The work was scheduled promptly, executed with precision, and completed exactly as promised. Attention to detail, craftsmanship, and follow-through were outstanding, and the job site was left clean and orderly. It is rare to find this level of reliability, transparency, and pride in workmanship. Gary sets a very high bar, and Overhead Garage Doors is fortunate to have him representing the company. Highly recommended without reservation.

reviews.text: Our garage door, which was last serviced a year and a half ago, started to make noise and its motion was choppy. We decided to be proactive and have it checked out before something broke. I called two days ago and scheduled service for yesterday. The quoted price for the service call seemed a little high but when I asked, I was told that the company offers discounts for military and seniors which put the price where I expected it to be. Edgar arrived on time. He was professional and friendly. His vehicle was clean. He got right to work examining the door. It took him about 10-15 minutes to lubricate the various parts and tighten the screws. He also checked and adjusted where the motor stopped when the door closed. I was happy with Edgar. I was happy with the service he provided. I was even more happy when he gave me the bill with a reduced price because he said it was a "minor" service.

They responded to my phone call quickly and had a technician out shortly after that. He was extremely helpful and honest and was able to replace two metal cross bars, reattach all the wood and get it back on tracks and running within the hour! So friendly and knowledgeable. Other places were trying to make me buy a whole new garage door for thousands of dollars, but they were able to replace and fix what was broken for less than $400. Honest, dependable, knowledgeable and trustworthy would be how I describe them! Just great!

reviews.text:
At 7:55 a.m. on a Thursday before a holiday weekend, my garage door suddenly came off track, and I couldn’t get it back into place myself. I called Overhead Door Company of Dallas right when they opened at 8:00 a.m., and Witt immediately treated my situation with urgency and dispatched Manny to my home.

Manny arrived promptly and was confident, professional, knowledgeable, and honest. After thoroughly assessing the problem, he clearly explained what was wrong and had my garage door repaired within 20 minutes, without needing to order any parts. Everything was fixed using his expertise, tools, and hands-on skill, which I truly appreciated.

He also took the time to provide helpful maintenance tips, showing me exactly how to lubricate my garage door, what lubricant to buy, and how often to use it. In addition, he recommended installing a surge protector for the garage door opener and explained why it would be beneficial.

The service fee was very reasonable and competitively priced, and I was happy to pay it. Thanks to Manny and Overhead Door Company of Dallas, my garage door was fully repaired well before lunchtime. That’s outstanding service, and I will definitely use them again for all of my garage door needs.

reviews.text:
9-4-2024  Jimmy Lee was friendly enough but tech stayed about 10 minutes and concluded whole new single garage door needed replacement for $2,250.  Nothing to fix - tracks, rollers, motor, and door panels were all bad but the spring was good.  All of that seemed so odd.  Called Jimmy Lee and he said they could do minor adjustments but would only last maybe 6 months and still would need a new door so might as well replace the whole door assembly.  Paid $190.

Called A & I1 Garage Door Repair and Adon came out and said the door panels and spring were fine, he did recommend replacing the motor and motor center bracket, top track brackets, 2 hinges installed incorrectly and tracks needed stronger support.  He reattached the track with much longer screws, made necessary adjustments, and gave me 2 yr service warranty - Paid $620.   2 hours of work.  You Decide....

I already scheduled A & I1 Garage Door Repair for my Mom's house and my Aunt's house.  It always costs you something to learn something, I learned I wont ever do business with Tarrant County Door & Gate.

reviews.text:
We had an outstanding experience with Professional Garage Concepts on multiple projects at our home in Keller, Texas.

Their team installed epoxy garage floor coatings in both our home garage and our new shop, including an extra-thick top coat that turned out fantastic. They also handled the garage doors and openers for the shop, and every part of the job was done exactly right. The finished product looks great and feels like tremendous value for the quality delivered.

What really stood out was the consultative approach from the owner, Shaun. These are products and services most homeowners don’t purchase often, so having someone knowledgeable walk through the options made a huge difference. Shaun took the time to make sure I understood the choices and felt confident in the solution we selected. That eliminated any worry about buyer’s remorse.

Our overall project took place across several phases over multiple months since we were building both a new home and a new shop. Professional Garage Concepts stayed consistent the whole way through with excellent communication and reliability, which is not always easy on long projects.

Another plus is their storefront right on Highway 377 in Keller. I had actually been waiting for them to move from Grand Prairie to Keller, so it’s great having them local now. Their showroom stocks a large selection of products, and they also have the skilled installation team to handle everything.

Bottom line: spot-on service, excellent workmanship, and a company that genuinely cares about getting it right.

I would absolutely use Professional Garage Concepts again and highly recommend them to anyone considering garage flooring, doors, storage systems, or related upgrades.

Our experience with Professional Garage Concepts (Daniel & Shaun) was fantastic. We were in need of a total makeover of our rug washing pit in Whitehouse, Texas. I highly recommend Overhead Door Company of Fort Worth. They are the only company I would trust in the Fort Worth area for garage door repair or installation. From start to finish, their team demonstrated honesty, expertise, and very competitive pricing.
Our service technician, Chris Williams, repaired our 8' x 14' garage door and did an outstanding job. He took the time to clearly explain what needed to be done before beginning the repair, and then completed the work efficiently and with great skill.
Prior to contacting Overhead Door Company, I had a very negative experience with another garage door repair business. The technician there was unprofessional, discourteous, and attempted to sell me parts that were not necessary. In contrast, Chris—who has 17 years of experience—was knowledgeable and trustworthy. He reassured me that the repair would be done correctly without any unnecessary add-ons, and he delivered exactly that.
If you’re looking for reliable, honest, and skilled garage door service, I wouldn’t consider anyone else.

★☆☆☆☆

As a homeowner at the Parks on Travis Condominiums, I have been extremely disappointed with our experience with Overhead Door Company of Fort Worth.

Our HOA hired this company to install a new garage door system, and since the installation in early May, we've had to have technicians return numerous times to address ongoing issues. From a homeowner's perspective, it's frustrating to see the same project require repeated service calls without a lasting resolution.

I live directly above the garage, so I'm affected more than most residents. Since the installation, the chain mechanism has produced a loud rolling noise that can be heard from inside my condo every time the garage operates. It has significantly impacted the enjoyment of my home, especially during the evenings and early mornings.

I spoke directly with two technicians during one of their recent visits and showed them a video demonstrating the noise. They acknowledged the issue and indicated they would work toward a solution. Unfortunately, the problem still exists.

Another concern is communication. From what I've experienced, different technicians have been sent out over multiple visits, and it doesn't appear there has been consistent communication from one service call to the next. That has made the repair process feel repetitive and inefficient.

I also noticed that after the initial installation, the control box was left exposed, which raised concerns about security and whether the project was truly complete before it was considered finished.

As a homeowner, I don't expect perfection. I do expect quality workmanship, thorough testing before a project is considered complete, and a commitment to resolving problems efficiently when they arise.

My hope is that someone from Overhead Door Company reviews our service history, sends a technician who is fully informed about the previous visits, and permanently resolves the excessive chain noise and any remaining installation issues.

I genuinely hope this review encourages better communication and follow-through because that's all our community has been asking for.

I’ve been using Plano Overhead for more than 10 years and always been happy with the level of professionalism and quality of work. Often times they are able to perform repair on the same day.  This time was no different when Jacob Wills arrived after my LiftMaster failed to open garage gate in the morning. Jacob quickly diagnosed the issue and gave me two options to either replace the failed belt or install a brand new unit due to its age. At no point did he pressure me to replace the entire unit and was happy to perform the spot repair. He also performed inspection and tune up of my entire garage door system since a lot of components have been installed by Plano Overhead over the years. Work was completed quickly and with high quality. This what keeps me coming back to Plano Overhead instead of trying to save a few dollars by seeking the cheapest quote.

I highly recommend Plano Overhead and hope they continue to offer the perfect balance of quality and price.

reviews.text:
Overall had a great experience with Nathan and his crew. Very quick to respond when I first reached out and was able to come out within a couple of hours from when I initially called. Nathan was able to look at our garage door which had been damaged after I accidentally backed into it (it was a cold morning, which made the rails contract and caused the sensors to misalign so while the door did open, it did not open fully and stopped so that the last section of the door was still blocking the opening). Our door was bent out of shape, off the rail, and the bottom trim had come off. In addition, the motor ended up breaking after testing it to see if it would still work.

Nathan was willing to fix the door and motor but in the end we decided it was more cost effective to just replace everything. Price was very reasonable and the removal and installation was quick and very well-done. Only “complaint” was that the crew arrived a little later than the expected window but Nathan was very good about reaching out and keeping me updated.

I am very happy with the new door (R-10) but even more excited about the weatherstripping they added to make sure the opening was completely sealed. Definitely recommend this company! Pictures below of before and after 🙂

reviews.text: A few business days ago as  I was letting my garage door up  I heard a popping sound but  I could not see what it was until a few hours later.  I panicked because my door is wooden and heavy and   I didn’t  want it to fall on my car or fall apart.  I went to Thumbstack and put my request in for a repair man and God did his thing when Jacob responded to my request. It would have been addressed the same day but Mother Nature caused heavy rain and flooding. Either way Jacob came the next morning accessed the damages and gave a verbal quote and  I agreed. Here’s the mind blowing part! He noticed my door screw came out which made the hinge loose.  He fixed it and all of the other screws that appeared loose. Then he said wait!, let me tighten your springs to help relieve tension. Then he said wait! The garage chain is limp and loose let me tighten. So Jacob went over and beyond. He was informative and knowledgeable. He didnt take advantage of me he made sure everything he noticed that was going to be a possible problem was fixed. If you need a professional for your garage go with DMX garage repair and ask specifically for Jacob.  I approve this message

reviews.text:
When my garage door spring broke, I decided it was the right time to upgrade to an insulated door, and I couldn’t be happier with the outcome. The team took the time to understand what mattered most to me and helped me choose the perfect door.

They scheduled the installation promptly, sent a reminder beforehand, and arrived exactly when they said they would. Throughout the process they were professional, knowledgeable, and extremely respectful of my home. They worked efficiently and left my garage cleaner than they found it.

What impressed me most was the extra care they took to walk me through proper maintenance. They even set up an automated reminder so I’ll know when it’s time to lubricate everything—making long‑term upkeep effortless.

Highly recommend their service.

reviews.text:
These guys are the best! I backed my car out of my garage and didn’t notice the door was not fully open. I creased the bottom panel of my double-sided, insulated garage door and was just sick about it. I started calling around for quotes and what I got was folks trying to upsell me by replacing the entire door. Until I called Joel! He came out today, matched the door panel perfectly, and replaced just what needed replacing.

He told me the guys at this business are NOT commission-based, so there’s not going to be any upselling. And he also lined the door thoroughly, cleaned up after himself, and tested it thoroughly before leaving.

This is a business you can trust and I recommend them highly.

reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a trustworthy garage door repair company, I highly recommend Your Garage Door Guys. They recently repaired my garage door, and the entire experience exceeded my expectations.

Spencer was the technician who handled my repair, and he was exceptional from start to finish. He thoroughly inspected my garage door, clearly explained the problem, and took the time to educate me on the repair process and my options without any pressure. His professionalism, honesty, and attention to detail immediately earned my confidence.

The repair was completed with excellent workmanship, and my garage door now operates better than it has in years. Spencer was knowledgeable, friendly, punctual, and genuinely cared about doing the job right.

What impressed me most is that employees like Spencer don’t happen by accident. They reflect the leadership and values of the owners and directors of the company. It’s obvious that Your Garage Door Guys has built a culture centered on integrity, quality craftsmanship, and outstanding customer service.

If you need garage door repair, garage door maintenance, or garage door service, I wouldn’t hesitate to call Your Garage Door Guys again. I am incredibly grateful for Spencer and the entire team, and I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone needing reliable garage door service.

reviews.text:
I recently used Veteran garage door to repair my garage doors and was very impressed with their service. Initially, both the large and small garage doors had severe dents and were only partially functional. The technicians arrived promptly, were extremely friendly, and completed the repair within one hour. After their work, both doors were operating smoothly and looked much better.
A short time later, the wire and spinning wheel came off, and the doors stopped opening and closing. Since my repair was under warranty, I contacted the Veteran garage door again. They responded immediately, scheduled a visit without delay, and quickly resolved the issue. The doors were restored to full working condition in no time.
Throughout both visits, the technicians demonstrated professionalism, politeness, and a high level of expertise. It is clear that they are highly skilled and knowledgeable in their field. I truly appreciate their efficiency and the quality of their work.
When the time comes to replace my garage doors with new ones, I will not hesitate to contact this company again. I would also strongly recommend their services to anyone in need of garage door repair or replacement. Their combination of technical skill, professionalism, and customer care is outstanding.

reviews.text: Like what usually happens with garage doors, I came home last night and as I raised my garage door, I hear a huge clunk and it stuck. A spring had broken and I couldn’t get the door up or down. This morning at 8 AM I called All American Doors and they answered the phone immediately. Sean said he’d have the supplies and be out by 1 PM. He contacted me an hour before and then 30 minutes before to let me know when he’d be there. When he showed up, he had the right parts and replaced both springs so I don’t have a problem with the other one. He also did an inspection and relocated a contact point due to some metal stress.. All that within 45 minutes and I was back up and running. It was good, fast work at a good price. You never know who you can count on in this business until you need them fast- I will recommend Sean at All American Doors to my friends and neighbors.

reviews.text: Johnnie Holloway arrived within 4 hours of my first call, assessed what he needed to buy to fix my residential garage door after someone ran into it, returned in less than 4 hours, and had the job finished about 2.5 hours later.  Two other companies quoted lower prices (without visiting my home to see how hard it would be to remove the old door without damaging the car inside the garage).  They were both going to install doors with one strut, perhaps with plastic/nylon wheels (bearings?).  Johnnie used some original high quality hardware from my old door, installed a new door with two struts, predicted it will last much longer than a door with one strut and flimsier hardware, explained that my old garage door opener is better than a new one would be, and explained and demonstrated how I can maintain it with a little attention every 6 months.  He hauled off the old broken door.  He gave me a written lifetime guarantee on all door hardware, and a 2 yr guarantee on labor.  I suspect Mr. Holloway is one of the most thorough and quality-conscious garage door repairmen and installers around.

raw.Description: Johnnie Holloway arrived within 4 hours of my first call, assessed what he needed to buy to fix my residential garage door after someone ran into it, returned in less than 4 hours, and had the job finished about 2.5 hours later.  Two other companies quoted lower prices (without visiting my home to see how hard it would be to remove the old door without damaging the car inside the garage).  They were both going to install doors with one strut, perhaps with plastic/nylon wheels (bearings?).  Johnnie used some original high quality hardware from my old door, installed a new door with two struts, predicted it will last much longer than a door with one strut and flimsier hardware, explained that my old garage door opener is better than a new one would be, and explained and demonstrated how I can maintain it with a little attention every 6 months.  He hauled off the old broken door.  He gave me a written lifetime guarantee on all door hardware, and a 2 yr guarantee on labor.  I suspect Mr. Holloway is one of the most thorough and quality-conscious garage door repairmen and installers around.

reviews.text: Very satisfied with Reliant. They were able to get out to give me an estimate very quickly and guaranteed me that no other company would beat their price. They were correct! After talking with me and giving my estimate he actually returned to place a lock on my current door as the previous homeowners never had one installed (crazy, right?). His words were "Everyone should feel safe in their home". This was done knowing that I had 2 other companies coming to give me pricing. That meant more than anything as a single mom, and even if his pricing had been al little higher, that made my mind up. Truly a company that cares about a potential customer. Thanks Alan and Reliant. I will recommend you to everyone I know!

reviews.text:
We invested approximately $80,000 with Reliant Doors for four high-end glass garage doors and one metal garage door, and unfortunately the experience has been extremely disappointing.

From the time they were installed, it took months of adjustments just to get the doors operating properly. It felt like we were constantly asking for what should be basic functionality, that the doors simply should go up when you press the up button and down when you press the down button. However, that was definitely not the case.

One of our contractors closed one of the doors and the half of the door came off the track. Thankfully no one was underneath it, because it easily could have caused a serious injury. On another occasion, a contractor pressed the open button and assumed the door had fully opened. Instead, it only opened about two-thirds of the way, causing his work van to strike the door trim.

When we contacted Reliant about replacing the damaged trim, Russ insisted it would cost us $3,000, even though the damage resulted from a door that had not been operating correctly shortly after installation. We reluctantly agreed because we just wanted the issue resolved. However, more than a year later, the replacement trim still has not been installed despite our payment agreement.

When you spend $80,000 on premium garage doors, you expect premium products, reliable operation, and a company that stands behind its workmanship. Unfortunately, that has not been our experience. Between the repeated adjustments, safety concerns, lack of accountability, and the ongoing failure to complete promised work, this has been incredibly frustrating.

If we had known the amount of time, money, and effort it would take to get these doors functioning properly and how difficult it would be to get Reliant to address problems we would have chosen another garage door company. We expected a premium experience for a premium price, and unfortunately that's not what we received.

reviews.text:
JAN 2025. MODERNISTIC  SEAN AND HELPER SHOWED UP LATE AND RIGHT AT DARK... THEY CUT SOO MANY CORNERS INSTALLING A 16' DOOR. IT WAS A TOTAL CLUSTER F INSTALLATION.
I had an appointment in Jan. between 11-3p with Modernistic Doors. They came at like Dark:30. Twas after 5 pm....So, these guys did not install some materials, they took those materials, and still have those in their possession. I am missing some self tapping screws, sheet metal screws, pull rope, long lag screws to attach header bracket above the drums, 2 pull handles, 4 L track brackets. and the weatherstrip stop molding. They pinched the existing sensor wiring under a door frame bracket.. That killed the opener sensor that
I  had to correct to close the door.. They refused to connect garage door opener that I paid had $150 extra for.
They refused to install stop moulding claiming in was only for elite orders.  That moulding was ordered and in their possession. I have 8 hours of my labor into these corrections so far.  I added latch, corrected strut placement as these braces were all installed in the wrong positions. Half of the lag screws only hit the drywall and not the house door frame. 1 set of rollers on 1 side of the door were installed in the wrong hinge holes due to track being installed too close to the house door frame. The overhead tracks were not parallel by like 4" and at different heights by a quite noticeable 2-3" heights. The strut horizontal braces were designed to be installed on a hinge screw or at the very top and bottom of the door, as there is no reinforced metal elsewhere. I repositioned the strut braces and plugged all the errant holes.. I added and repositioned longer lag screws to properly connect the L brackets to the house frame. I corrected all the above issues.
They literally threw this door up..It was truly a miracle that the door worked at all...They eventually brought the weatherstrip moulding and curb dropped that. These guys don't deserve the full labor reimbursement.

reviews.text:
6/17/26 review:
I reported a loose cable that left my garage door slanted, and technician Benjamin arrived in under two hours. Team member Crystal called ahead with a 1:30 PM ETA, which I appreciated. Benjamin quickly diagnosed the issue, realigned the cable, and re-torqued the springs. He also pointed out that my aging plastic rollers were creating resistance and replaced them with neoprene ball-bearing rollers. Taking care of that preventative maintenance now gives me confidence I’ve avoided a more costly repair later. Professional, prompt, and thorough service.

9/3/25 review:
Technician Benjamin was super responsive and took time answering my questions during the overnight emergency phone hours. The following morning, he promptly arrived before 8:30am CST to efficiently replace my broken garage door springs within an hour (team member Kayla gave me a courtesy call beforehand to inform me of his ETA). A1 Affordable Garage Door springs are oil soaked springs so I like that they arrive pre-lubricated compared to unlubed galvanized steel springs. More importantly, he showed me recommended DIY maintenance tips on the garage door springs, hinges and rollers.

reviews.text: Let me first say that I cannot recommend John and Meadows enough. The professionalism won me over for replacing my garage door. They gave me a 2 hour window and showed up on time! (A different company gave us a 4 hour window and were 30 mins late). John really listened to how we used our garage door and recommended the best option, even an option to repair the door for much less than a new door. (Repair wasn’t even offered with the other company and their least expensive option was thousands more than John’s quote). We were given an almost seamless ability to choose a financing option that was built into our cost estimate. (The other company gave us the “let me check in the warehouse” slightly better deal and only offered financing as a DO IT NOW! tactic). When it came time to install the door, John was on time (5 mins early), helped me get my hiding cat into the house, and took extra care to not let the other cats get out. He installed the door quickly (<3 hours), cleaned up the area, took the old door and trash with him, and walked us through everything he had done. It’s unfortunate that we will probably not get very many chances to recommend John and Meadows very often, but I can guarantee he will get every recommendation that I can give.

I cannot say enough good things about Viking Overhead!

My garage door completely broke off during last night’s storm and was literally laying on the ground. I reached out to them at 9:08 PM expecting to maybe hear back the next day, but Whitney responded within TWO minutes and had me scheduled immediately for today between 10–12.

Not only was their communication fast and professional, but the technician, Trey, actually arrived 20 minutes early. He assessed everything, gave me a very reasonable quote, and got right to work.

What I thought was going to be a complete disaster was repaired flawlessly in just a few hours. Trey rebuilt the entire garage door, repaired all of the tracks, installed a brand new spring system, and had everything finished by 1 PM.

I am beyond impressed with the speed, professionalism, and quality of craftsmanship. Honestly, my garage door has NEVER worked this smoothly before. It feels brand new.

If you need garage door repair, do not hesitate to call Viking Overhead. Their emergency response, customer service, and workmanship truly exceed 5 stars.

Highly, highly recommend!

After several consultations with other door installers I choose Viking based on reviews, skills and price.  I even drove out to their office in Burleson to meet them and was impressed.   They did a great job of installing the 2 new Coplay 9208 doors.  Really enjoy the new openers too.
I was disappointed a bit in that they could not use the vinyl trim that goes around the parameter to give it a complete seal.   I needed the entire installation to match the modern metal on the house with no wood grain.  The only trim they have is bulky with deep wood grain.  They did minimize the crack around the parameter as much as possible but it still lets some air through.  Surely there is some sort of trim that would work and I will continue to look for it.
Otherwise, great job Viking... love my new doors!

reviews.text:
Please humor me in following along with this lengthy review regarding my experience today with Imperial Overhead Garage Door Repair.  Wife and I were enjoying some dinner last night when we heard that stomach-turning, crashing, loud sound, coming from the garage;  that if you've ever had a garage spring break on you, its a very familiar sound that you never want to hear.  I immediately sent a message on Google requesting estimates.  I received over 10 estimates in 5 minutes. Some estimates were very low, but the ratings for most of those companies were "concerning."

Fast forward to today, Friday. I had a company lined up to come to the house at noon.  However, I received a text after noon stating that the technician was re-routed and that it would be 'later'.  'Later' then turned into 'can't make it today, but can come out on Sunday'.

I was then faced with a decision -  to wait until Sunday for a very low price, or find someone that could come out on a Friday afternoon on short notice and hopefully, provide a reasonable quote.  I chose to take my chances and search for a company that could come out today.  Because Imperial had nearly 100% 5-Star reviews and the owner responds to nearly all reviews, I gave Imperial a call. I spoke first with Joe, who was very helpful, provided a reasonable price range and said he could send someone in 30 minutes.  I then began texting with Nick, who is the owner, and who was equally friendly, professional and helpful.  I was told that Bret (Technician Manager) had finished his previous job and was on his way to my home.  Brett arrived, very professional, friendly, and extremely knowledgable. Brett has worked on garage doors nearly his entire life and could probably replace a garage spring with a blindfold.

Bret completed the job in less than 30 minutes and was then on his way out.  The price was great and the work and professionalism was equally fantastic!

Thank you Bret!  If anyone is needing garage door work, just make one call to Imperial, you will be pleased.  Spoken from a new customer for life!

reviews.text:
We have a large 2-car garage with a heavy 800 lb door and a side mounted motor. The support strings on one side broke, causing the door to drop unevenly and come out of the tracks, leaving one side fully down and the other halfway up. With both cars parked inside, it was a very risky situation.

A couple of technicians initially tried to fix it and to their credit were transparent in acknowledging they were not the right fit for a door of this size and complexity. That’s when we contacted Imperial Overhead Garage Door Repair. Brett came out on a weekend with very short notice, quickly diagnosed the issue, explained exactly what had failed, and provided a clear, fair estimate. He resolved the entire problem cleanly and safely within a couple of hours.

The price was very reasonable given the expertise, speed, and weekend emergency support. Brett also adjusted the tracks and relubed them, which made a noticeable improvement in the smoothness and overall feel of the door.

We are now signing up for their annual maintenance plan based on the confidence they earned from this experience. I highly recommend Brett and Imperial Overhead Garage Door Repair for their professionalism, honesty, expertise, and responsiveness.

reviews.text: We recently replaced the original garage door from 1991 on the home we bought in 2013.  Terry Davis was extremely friendly and set us up for a next morning appt.  Lead tech Allen Von arrived on time, showed us the damage, offered us a cost to 'patch' the issue or a price to fully replace the door (which was absolutely needed!) and said the motor was in great shape and wouldn't require replacement.  The crew arrived on time and installed a perfect door in less than an hour.  The reason for the review however is the follow up work we had.  Last night my daughters left a tailgate open after getting their softball gear out and shut the garage without noticing.  This morning when the went to open the garage it caught the tailgate on the way up, bent the door and did cosmetic damage on the vehicle.  Totally our fault.  I called Terry Davis this morning when they opened, explained what happened and he offered to have someone out same day.  Allen Von once again arrived at our home - took a good look and said the damage was minimal, bent the door back into shape, tested it multiple ways - showed me what to keep an eye one 'just in case' but that we shouldn't have any issues with it ----and then did not charge me anything since they had just installed it and he was already in the area.  This is the type of customer service and quality effort that will make us customers for life and make sure anyone we know in need of garage door service contacts them.  Can't thank you enough for being such an excellent company with superior customer service!

I own multiple rental properties across the DFW area and manage them remotely from overseas. Finding reliable service companies has always been a challenge, but Express Garage Door has been exceptional.
What makes them stand out is their 24/7 availability - I can reach them anytime regardless of time zones, which is crucial when you're managing properties from abroad. They respond quickly, usually getting to my properties same day or next day depending on urgency.
Their process is perfect for remote property owners: they send photos of the issues, provide fair pricing for approval before doing the work, and keep me informed throughout. My tenants consistently tell me how professional and efficient the technicians are.
If you're a property owner or investor managing DFW rentals, especially from out of state or internationally, I highly recommend Express Garage Door. They make long-distance property management so much easier.

reviews.text:
Alex, their technician came by on a Tuesday to take measurements and discuss options. He explained my best options for replacing the rollup door on my shop. I get why people choose a rollup door it’s cheaper but when you have tornado winds they don’t hold up, they flex and that’s what happens to ours. The door blew in and I couldn’t get it to budge. Both of my options were basically to go with a standard panel door with a side mount motor (best thing ever). Alex called around to make sure parts and everything were available and wrote up the estimate and explained everything. Price was what I was expecting. He was able to get the installation scheduled in 2 days (Thursday). Installation crew showed up a little early and got right to. I wanted to see how they were going to remove the rollup door. Cut, pry and a lot of muscle work but they got it out. Install was pretty quick too.
From start to finish was excellent. I still need to add some edge seal but hey the door looks awesome and the motor is so quiet. My neighbor is a little jealous I guess you can say.
I HIGHLY Recommend Express Garage Door.

reviews.text: Incredible job!  Joey showed up early, diagnosed the problem quickly and assisted me in an educated solution.  Because of a faulty circuit board, which was going to cost around $325 to replace, we ended up deciding to replace our 19 year old LiftMaster with a new belt drive LiftMaster which was only $100 more than the new chain drive.  And this new system is way way better, with much bigger and brighter lighting, a Wifi camera, phone app to open and close remotely it's much quieter opening and closing.  It was very hot, but he stayed until the job was fully complete, including lubing my door wheels, helping me sync the new opener to my Wifi (which we had to do multiple times because I didn't remember my password) and programing the new remotes and cars to the new system including my separate driveway gate so we I don't have to use different remotes.  He said he would come back if I had any issues, especially with the Wifi. Extremely professional, polite and friendly.  Great guy!  Would highly recommend O'Brien and Joey to anyone in need of servicing your garage doors.

WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!!!
Serviceman that came out was visibly upset when he arrived.(On the phone, I could hear it in his tone, he was upset). When he arrived, I jokingly asked if he was okay, as he sounded flustered on the phone. He said yes and said something about  an incident at 6a.m. I told him my garage door went down, I heard a crash, and not it doesn't open. Without inspection, he said broken spring and NO ONE can open your door. Ironically, he then made a call, spoke in his dialect and  stated it would cost $650.00 to open my garage! I said thanks, but no thanks. He asked how much do you want to pay. I told him. He said no one will charge you that. I said okay. He wanted to argue/negotiate asking, " How much do you want to pay?" I advised, sir, it's fine. I am not paying $650.00 for you to open my garage and not repair it. He got in his vehicle and drove off.
By the way, got my garage opened for free and repaired for less than his price.

reviews.text: Called this company at 10pm on a Friday evening.  I was worried my garage door was going to cave in on my car.  The person answered the phone and came out to repair my door. I felt very comfortable that he knew what he was doing and he was very pleasant considering coming out to repair late on a Friday is not optima..  Great experience.  I gave them a 4 stars instead of 5 because it did take him a while to get here.  I would say about 1.5 hours.  Apparently he was having dinner when I called.  Again, I am glad he came out and charged a reasonable price and was honest, fair and knowledgeable.  Just the timing on his arrival seemed a bit much.  Will definitely use them again!

All of the other places I called didn't even offer this as an option to consider.  Very happy with his work and would recommend him again for anyone considering having someone else swap out their openers and don't want to embark on it on their own. He's also a military veteran so be sure to thank him for his service if you hire him!

reviews.text:
COMPLETELY SHADY AND UNPROFESSIONAL.

Our initial consultation was great, but everything after that was a disaster. We agreed to replace four garage door panels and signed an estimate for $1,600 after negotiations. I paid a $900 deposit to get the work started.

The company repeatedly rescheduled appointments, failed to show up as promised, and never proactively communicated delays. One missed appointment even caused me to miss work and repeatedly reschedule my realtor’s photography appointment while preparing to sell our home.

When a technician finally arrived, he only brought 2 of the 4 panels we had discussed and claimed the estimate only covered two panels. The price then suddenly increased from $1,600 to $2,500. I never signed any revised agreement reflecting that increase.

After the work was completed, they pressured me for immediate payment of the disputed balance, attempted to run financing through a third party, wanted to run credit checks on multiple household members, and refused to simply invoice the remaining amount. I ultimately provided a post-dated check under pressure.

To make matters worse, after my wife left a review, the owner texted her directly, became confrontational, claimed they were doing us a favor, and could not identify a single thing they could have done better. The entire experience was disorganized, unprofessional, and frustrating from start to finish.

I would not recommend this company based on my experience. We will be taking legal action! You have been warned!

reviews.text:
I highly recommend this construction company for your expansions, and repairs on your home. They replaced all my rotted siding with concrete wood siding that is guaranteed not to rot; I think. Replaced the outer door frame of both my exterior doors, and primed and painted my garage door. We had them paint the garage door because I changed the color of the siding, fascia, awnings, etc. Even sub-contracted the gutter company and recommended the color for the gutters; the gutters come in a variety of colors and the green color for the gutters did not go well/ I didn't like the color/ contractor didn't like the color of green the gutters came in. Since he contracted the gutter installation company, all my payments went to my contractor and he paid the subcontractor. The work crew was very courteous as well. The owner of the construction company, RJ was very personable and I deemed him to be honest and his price for the job was reasonable as well. They are opening an office here in Trenton which makes it very convenient to make an appointment or to stop by and discuss matters in a timely fashion. Payments for our home repairs were done in installments at different completion stages, this way we knew the job would be completed. We've heard many stories of contractors skipping out when paid in full upfront before the work has even begun or partially done; that was reassuring. He built an addition to our neighbor's home and it was great inside and out, couldn’t tell it was an addition.

I felt like I had a new home, it's gorgeous!

reviews.text:
We worked with RJ and his crew at EXL between January and June 2023 on a 1500sqft addition to our home! We added on a large master suite and laundry room on the 1st level and two bedrooms, one bath, and a flex space on the 2nd level. And a covered 16x8 cedar deck integrated with the roofline!

To sum things up, RJ and his crew were awesome to work with!!! Honest, fair, competent, great communication, great workmanship, etc!!! RJ keeps his word and we would definitely recommend EXL Construction!

From the very beginning RJ was competent and had an excellent grasp of what we wanted and how to get it done. RJ was fair and flexible in all matters; small changes to plans here and there, fixing mistakes, being upfront and timely about delays or changes, and of course in project pricing/estimates.

Communication with RJ was timely, thorough, and honest. He was always willing to hear our concerns or discuss any other project details, and in turn answer and address things in a timely manner.

The construction timeline was quick and went smoothly. Framing was completed in just 2 weeks! Materials and quality of workmanship were top-notch. Also, RJs crew and any other subs he had to bring in were always very respectful and kept a tidy workspace.

Integration with the existing home was seamless and RJ did a great job finding a brick supplier to get a great match.

All in all, we were very pleased with the work done!

reviews.text:
Extreme line Construction satisfied customer!

RJ (owner) and his team exceeded our expectations during the addition of approximately 500 square feet to our home, which included a new bedroom with a walk-in closet and attic access, a beautifully designed bathroom, and an extended media room. The quality of their work is solid—everything blends seamlessly with the rest of house, as if the additions were always there.

RJ’s communication and professionalism stood out throughout the project. He is a great listener and addressed any concerns we had without hesitation. For example, when there were some issues with the vanity and a few minor imperfections, RJ and his team promptly fixed everything with great quality—even satisfying my wife’s very high standards and attention to detail. Their flexibility to accommodate our needs made the process smooth and stress-free.

What impressed us even more, without the pressure to achieve, was that the project was completed ahead of schedule—8 weeks instead of the expected 12—and stayed exactly within the agreed-upon budget. This level of speed, quality and transparency was surprising to us (we had done other remodels with other contractors with tough experiences). Speaks to the team’s excellent planning and execution.

We couldn’t be happier with the outcome. The media room’s enhanced lighting and speaker setup is amazing, the bathroom is top-notch, and the bedroom layout—with its angles and spacious walk-in closet—is perfect for our needs. These additions have truly transformed our home, making it feel like a brand-new space and a new feel to our home.

I highly recommend Extreme Line Construction for any home addition or remodeling project. Skilled, reliable and pleasure getting to know.

Pictures included are media room, hallway to new bed/bath/closet.

RJ (owner) and his team exceeded our expectations during the addition of approximately 500 square feet to our home, which included a new bedroom with a walk-in closet and attic access, a beautifully designed bathroom, and an extended media room. The quality of their work is solid—everything blends seamlessly with the rest of house, as if the additions were always there.

RJ’s communication and professionalism stood out throughout the project. He is a great listener and addressed any concerns we had without hesitation. For example, when there were some issues with the vanity and a few minor imperfections, RJ and his team promptly fixed everything with great quality—even satisfying my wife’s very high standards and attention to detail. Their flexibility to accommodate our needs made the process smooth and stress-free.

What impressed us even more, without the pressure to achieve, was that the project was completed ahead of schedule—8 weeks instead of the expected 12—and stayed exactly within the agreed-upon budget. This level of speed, quality and transparency was surprising to us (we had done other remodels with other contractors with tough experiences). Speaks to the team’s excellent planning and execution.

We couldn’t be happier with the outcome. The media room’s enhanced lighting and speaker setup is amazing, the bathroom is top-notch, and the bedroom layout—with its angles and spacious walk-in closet—is perfect for our needs. These additions have truly transformed our home, making it feel like a brand-new space and a new feel to our home.

I highly recommend Extreme Line Construction for any home addition or remodeling project. Skilled, reliable and pleasure getting to know.

Pictures included are media room, hallway to new bed/bath/closet.

reviews.text: This company and team are some of the best guys I have had the pleasure of hiring to construct my patio.  It’s been 2 1/2 years and I am still so happy with the quality of product and work they produced.  When I was looking to build I reached out to get quotes for 5-6 different companies, EXL was not the cheapest nor the most expensive.  They did however have the best quality of materials used and knowledge for the job.  The one thing that stood out the most is when they came to do the bid they offered ideas for the design based on what I wanted ( at the time I really didn’t know exactly what that was) RJ was very patient he listened, asked the right kind of questions, drew out sketches, made adjustments and then handled everything from there. I From start to finish including city inspections it took 3 weeks to complete and it turned out better than I could have imagined. During the process I was kept in the loop and knew what to inspect when.  They completed a 40x18 foot 10 inch deep stamped concrete pad with a patio cover of 2 gables, can lights, ceiling fans, and heaters.  My little oasis is a perfect escape I can relax with my husband or entertain with friends.  I am still beyond thrilled with my purchase and this team.  I definitely will use them again for some other home remodeling I’ll do in the future.

We needed more space for our growing family, 3 kids, 2 dogs, and my mother-in-law moved in last year So we started looking into adding an ADU out back and a buddy told me about EXL. I was kinda nervous to even start cause I've never done anything like this before, but RJ and his crew made it way easier than I expected.
They helped us figure out the layout, permits, even small things like where to put windows for better light.
Communication was on point, i'd get updates almost every day, and they stuck to the timeline even with some rain delays. Budget stayed tight too, no surprise charges. The guys were super respectful, cleaned up every day (big deal with little kids around), and honestly did a killer job.
The finished ADU looks amazing. We use it now as a guest house and sometimes I work out of there too. If you're looking for an ADU builder in Texas, EXL is for real the way to go. Can't recommend them enough.

I had a great experience with Anytime Garage Door Repair and wanted to share a quick note of appreciation.

James, our technician, was exceptional from start to finish. He showed up on time in little elm, communicated clearly, and immediately made the situation feel straightforward and under control. What stood out most was his approach to customer service — professional, respectful, and genuinely focused on helping rather than upselling.

He quickly diagnosed the issue — a damaged strut — and presented a cost-effective solution that made sense, then handled the replacement efficiently and with care. No wasted time, no confusion — just solid, reliable work.

It’s not always easy to find service providers who balance expertise with strong communication, but James absolutely delivered on both.

Highly recommend Anytime Garage Door Repair, and if you can request James, you’ll be in great hands!

Dylan from Anytime Garage Door did an excellent job servicing my garage door in Frisco. He came out and fixed the broken spring and replaced the rollers, and the difference is night and day. The garage door is now running much smoother, quieter, and feels much more secure.

Dylan was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain what was going on instead of just rushing through the job. He showed up prepared, handled the repair efficiently, and made sure everything was working properly before leaving. You can tell he knows what he is doing and takes pride in his work.

I really appreciated his attention to detail, communication, and overall customer service. It is hard to find people who are both skilled and personable, but Dylan checked both boxes. I would absolutely recommend Dylan and Anytime Garage Door to anyone in Frisco or the surrounding area who needs garage door repair, spring replacement, roller replacement, or general service. Great experience from start to finish.

My warranty company used them as the dispatch service to fix my opener and I’m left with a severely broken garage door (brand new from 12/23) and opener. They knew my opener was broke and they clicked it anyways, left my door open and caused a large dent, then sent an email saying everything worked properly (lie). They were at my property for 4 minutes. I then went to shut my garage door, since they said it was working fine and everything fell down and crumbled.

I tried contacting multiple times for support and Rob blocked my number from texting after gaslighting me by saying I left the manual slide lock out which was not the case. I had to pay another company to help get the door shut ($450) and was quoted $1950 for a new door and $300 for opener. This is all on Overhead Door Pros based in Crowley, TX behalf. This company needs to fess up and correct their mistakes. They delete reviews and have left a new home owner in a pool of messes.

Small claims court here we come.

I ordered 4 large dark bronze door units for my new home.  They came out to put final hardware on 8 months later and got a service wrong work order for another job and coppered all 4 doors.  They came out to "fix" and painted them and now you see the sheen through the paint and they look nothing like the steel doors I had before.  The owner is telling me it's fine and that was the process and not a mix up in service orders.  Even though it was 8 months later and the service manager told me it was when I contacted them the minute I saw it.  Would not recommend this company that doesn't not stand behind correcting their mistakes and telling you it fine when you paid 80k.

And you can read his response to see what you will deal with!   The photos don't lie and he has never come out to see them once.

reviews.text:
I had some really unpleasant experiences with this company. It was my gate that had track broken, they came out quoted me a reasonable number to change it. I later added to get the gate chain replaced as that’s old. Their number for chain alone was high but I decided to gave all my business to them. When they came for work, it was subcontracted, and the guy told me they were to use the old track which was broken. I asked the sales person and he insisted that’s what we agreed. I checked contact it said “new v track concrete install”. I didn’t want to deal with that verbiage so I cancelled that service with them. But in order to get my deposit back, I had to go with them to change the chain. I blame myself for not being careful with the contract and was going to just let it go.
A month later, the chain they installed came off. I put it back without calling those guys. Honestly don’t understand how they can mess up such a simple thing. This time I decided to leave a review so others may learn from my mistake. Be extra careful with them, they may give you a number that’s reasonable, but contract could be something vague. They subcontractor out, and their job quality is questionable as I can see here.

The quality of the door is amazing with overlapping edges on both sides to make it airtight. The outer glass is mirror-like so no one can see in during the day. The painter painted the new trim, touched up the brick, touched up the door.  They do everything so you do not need someone else to come and do anything. The door is beautiful.  I thought from our discussions with the sales person, this would be a good process but they exceeded my expectations!  You should know they can give you an estimate of your doors arrival but it could be off a month or more so do not purchase for an event with a hard date. This was fine for us however and worked out.
I highly recommend them!

reviews.text: Our garage doors had gotten really noisy, so we called a local garage door installer for help. They quickly sent out a technician named Jacob to check things out and handle any repairs. Before he arrived, we got a text letting us know Jacob was on his way, and it mentioned he was highly skilled, really loves animals, and is a veteran. At first, I thought that might be a bit of an exaggeration, but after meeting Jacob, I realized he really is as great as they said! Jacob listened carefully as he tested our garage doors, and right away he figured out what was wrong. He used a tablet to show us two options: one for repairing the issue and one for replacing the doors, making it easy for us to choose what worked best. We decided to go with the repair option. While I went to grab the mail, Jacob got straight to work, and by the time I came back, the job was already finished! The doors were quiet again and working perfectly. Jacob was professional, friendly, and took the time to explain everything clearly. He was down-to-earth and easy to talk to. As a fellow veteran and animal lover myself, I appreciated those personal touches. I’m really happy with the service and will definitely recommend this garage door company and Jacob to my friends and neighbors.

reviews.text: When our old chain drive garage door opener stopped working, we started looking for solutions, but most of the quotes we got were really expensive. We contacted a local garage door repair company and they sent someone out quickly—within an hour of our call. Donovan checked out our opener and let us know it couldn’t be fixed, but he offered several replacement options and explained the benefits of each in a way that was easy to understand. We chose the Liftmaster 8355 because the price was much better than what other companies had quoted us. The team came back the next day and installed everything efficiently. Both Donovan and Jacob were very friendly and knowledgeable, and they made sure we understood how the new opener worked. If you need garage door repair or a new opener in Texas, I highly recommend this company for their fast service and great prices.

reviews.text: When we moved into our 'new' home, the garage door was already pretty old and it finally gave out one afternoon, folding right in the middle. A neighbor helped me get it closed enough to keep things safe, and we decided it was time to call for professional garage door repair. I contacted jared's garages and left a message even though it was after hours. Early Monday, jacob called me back and I sent him a picture of the damage. He came by soon after to look things over and gave us a quote for a new garage door. We decided to go ahead with the replacement, and we’re really happy we did. On installation day, donovan and another tech arrived right on time. I have some experience with tools and building things myself, and I was truly impressed by their work. They handled every step with care, making sure the new garage door fit perfectly and worked smoothly. You can tell this company has been doing garage door installs and repairs for a long time. I would definitely recommend them to anyone needing garage door service, especially in texas where you want a reliable door to keep out the heat.

reviews.text:
I am so pleased with my experience at DFW Door Repair. They were very communicative; understanding my vision from the start. Consultations were done via the phone, giving me the ability to text them inspiration and them having a clear expectation. The sales team was patient and accommodating. They helped give valuable advice and recommendations based on my budget, aesthetics, and inspiration. I really appreciated their objective advice and recommendations (they didn’t come across as pushy or salesy at all). They have a robust amount of options to fit any kind of style, budget, and customizations. We chose to go with a fiberglass double door, replacing a single door and sidelights.
Then once the door was ordered it took tremendously longer than anticipated to come in, at no fault of DFW Door Repair. Grace continually kept me updated and was a pleasure to work with. The team who came out and took measurements were on time, friendly, and clean.
When the door came, they prepared it in record time to get it installed quickly. The instillation team was phenomenal. They were clean, quick, and thorough. We had significant structural changes and they were very well versed and experienced. I had new hardware ready for them to installed and it all looks exactly how I described to them.
I am incredibly happy with the overall process. I’d highly recommend them.

reviews.text:
I was furious at being charged a fairly sizable amount for repairs after barely using my new garage door in the 6-7 months since installed, as I’d been traveling out of state every few week.  I was told my 90-day warranty period had expired for my specific issue claim, and yet the problems had started within that time frame but I was so busy and often times away that I never reported the issue.
Well, after calming down, I recognize that the gentleman who serviced me was excellent as before, and the product quality itself was still very good.  Natural shifting of my home & garage walls ever so slightly - lots of rain, lots of heat in the past months didnt help - had resulted in the problem with the garage door closing inconsistently, sometimes requiring 4-5 attempts…not their fault.
I still stand by my initial reviews at installation they are a quality org with quality service and products, in my case removing old garage door and connections and installing a completely new door and set-up, disposing of the old equipment.

reviews.text: When our garage door spring broke in half, I reached out to this company expecting it would take a while for someone to come out. To my surprise, Timothy arrived the very next day to check things out. Since we had already been thinking about getting new garage doors and openers, I asked Timothy for a quote. He quickly called the main office to get all the details, and while he was securing my broken spring, I received several quotes by email with all the different options I was interested in. Once the parts arrived, the team came back the following business day to install everything. They even subtracted the cost of the initial repair from our final bill, which was a pleasant surprise. Our new garage doors look fantastic and run smoothly and quietly, which is perfect for the hot Texas weather. On top of that, they provide a warranty on all their work for three years, which gives us great peace of mind. I highly recommend this garage door installer for anyone needing fast, professional, and friendly service.

reviews.text: We really love Gold Tech Garage Repair. They came to my mom’s home in Plano after her oversized two-car garage door had bent badly and jumped off the tracks. One section was folded so much you could see outside, and the tracks and rails were twisted, so it looked like the whole garage door system would need to be replaced. Instead of pushing for a full new door and a huge bill, Samuel said they could likely repair the damaged garage door and hardware. They fixed it and got everything working smoothly again. They straightened the bent track, repaired the door panels as much as possible, replaced the worn plastic rollers with strong metal rollers, and handled a few other needed garage door repairs and adjustments. I really appreciated their honesty, especially because this was for my senior mom. In the Texas heat, having a safe and working garage door again was a big relief. The price was very fair, and now the garage door opens and closes like new. Great service, honest work, and real integrity.

reviews.text: This is the second time I've used this garage door repair company in Farmersville, and both experiences have been excellent! Since my previous door guy retired, I needed someone reliable, and they delivered. Caleb did a fantastic job—he arrived right on time, was polite, professional, and knew exactly what to do. I called their office late in the evening, and they still answered and scheduled me for the next morning. My garage door uses extra-strong springs because it’s 8 feet tall. Caleb explained that he didn’t have the exact springs with him and could have used regular ones, but he wanted to do it right. He let me know he’d come back with the right parts, which I really appreciated. While he was there, Caleb also repaired some minor impact damage I hadn’t noticed, and he even lubricated the new springs and all the moving parts on both of my garage doors, not just the one he was fixing. The price was very fair for the work done. If you need garage door repairs or a new door in Farmersville, I highly recommend giving this company a call. They truly care about doing the job right and treating customers well.

reviews.text: I used to run a large business where customer service mattered every day, and we always believed in treating people the way you want to be treated. Early that morning, right before a planned road trip, our overhead garage door came off the track, bent up badly, and trapped the car inside the garage. With only a few hours before we hoped to leave, it looked like our whole day was going to be thrown off. I called for garage door service around 6:30 in the morning, just hoping someone could help quickly. After a short call, they said a technician would come out within the hour. Jesse arrived promptly, inspected the damaged garage door, freed the car, removed the broken sections, and got a new door installed much sooner than we expected. What looked like a major garage door emergency turned into a smooth repair and replacement experience. We were still able to get on the road that same day with only a short delay. The whole experience showed strong customer care, skilled garage door work, and real follow-through. If you need overhead door repair, off-track door service, or a full garage door replacement in Farmersville, this was the kind of help you hope for.

Now the garage door runs smooth, quiet, and closes evenly to the ground. It feels much safer and more reliable than before. Even with the heat and daily use in Krum, the door has continued to work perfectly. We are very happy with the service and the quality of the repair.

reviews.text: I had a very good experience with the garage door service team. My garage door and opener were due for a routine tune-up and safety inspection, so I scheduled service and they were able to come out with short notice, which was very helpful. The tune-up price was fair, and Joseph was professional, friendly, and easy to talk to. During the visit, Joseph checked the full garage door system, including the opener, tracks, rollers, and torsion spring. He found that the spring tension had not been set correctly before, and he clearly explained that leaving it that way could put extra strain on the opener motor over time. He adjusted it properly while he was there for a reasonable added cost, even though that repair is not usually part of a standard maintenance visit. I appreciated the honest advice, quick response, and quality garage door repair work. The door runs smoother, feels more balanced, and the opener is working better now. I would definitely recommend this company for garage door tune-ups, inspections, and spring adjustment service.

reviews.text: Choosing the right garage door for your home can be a lot more involved than most people expect. I did not realize how many details matter until we started the process. We were very glad to work with Joseph and Darrell, who guided us through every step and made the whole garage door selection much easier. They explained how each home and garage setup is different, and how things like door size, panel style, color, insulation, durability, and the right garage door opener all affect what works best. They also helped us think about everyday use, curb appeal, and long term performance, which gave us a lot more confidence in our decision. Joseph and Darrell were patient the entire time, answered our questions clearly, and gave helpful recommendations without making the process feel overwhelming. The installation was completed professionally, everything was adjusted properly, and the garage was left very clean when the work was done. We are extremely happy with the new garage doors and opener. The price was fair, the materials and workmanship were excellent, and the final look fits our home beautifully. The doors operate smoothly, feel solid, and have already made a big difference in both convenience and appearance. Based on the great service and overall quality, we would gladly recommend this garage door company in Krum.

reviews.text: My wife and I have used Taylor's Garages a few times for garage door service, and every experience has been excellent. The first time, I needed help pairing a new remote with an older garage door opener. I set up a service call, but before the installer came out, Joseph called and explained that the setup was simple. He walked me through the programming steps over the phone and saved me the cost of a service visit. He was patient, helpful, and I got the remote working at no charge. More recently, our garage door spring snapped and the technician arrived quickly, inspected the system, and completed the repair fast. After the spring replacement and tune-up, the door was running smoothly again and sounded much quieter, almost like new. The whole process felt professional and honest. We also had a tight week financially because of some unexpected bills, and when I asked if they could wait a little before charging my card, they were very understanding. They agreed without any extra fee or hassle, which meant a lot to us. It is not often you find a garage door company that is this fair, responsive, and easy to work with. I would gladly recommend them to anyone needing garage door opener help, spring repair, or general garage door service.

reviews.text:
TLDR: Do not use them for residential services. They treat customers like garbage (unless you are a big spender/contractor). Took two and a half months to get a door when we were told it would take two weeks. They made mistake after mistake. Everyone we spoke to was rude.

Resdoor has been an absolute nightmare and I am so happy to get to wipe my hands of them forever. We ordered our door on April 12th with Dennis and were told it would take two weeks to complete. The door was finally ready on June 28th, two and a half months later. Dennis retired a few days after we ordered our door and he apparently didn’t pass his smaller projects on to anybody. When we went to pick up our door, we found that it was built to standard measurements, not the custom measurements we had specified. Also we ordered a half-pane of glass and the door they made for us was ¾ pane glass. However, because our salesperson had retired, nobody was available to help us. We spoke to someone who assured us he would order it correctly and that it would be ready in two weeks. When we called two weeks later to check on the door, nobody could find the order. Apparently it was never placed. My husband talked to someone who mentioned that they would trim down the old door and it would be ready in a few days. We had to demand that they remake the door, as trimming it down to our measurements would not fix the fact that we ordered ½ pane glass and the door was ¾ pane. Everytime I called, somebody rude would answer the phone and ask for the name of our salesperson. When I said Dennis, I would get audible grumbles or sighs (because he doesn’t work there anymore and apparently I was now creating work for someone else). When the door was finally ready, I asked if someone could send us a picture so that we could verify that the door was correct this time. The woman told me that it wasn’t possible because it would require a busy employee to go back into the warehouse (the audacity that I would suggest that) and use their personal phone to take a photo of the door. I told her that I was patient (it didn’t have to happen right that second, I could wait a bit), and that the employee could use their personal phone but send an email to themselves and then forward it to us. The woman finally agreed and someone sent my husband a picture of the door, which finally looked correct.

Meanwhile, at my house, my broken front door was leaking water every time it rained. We are not “custom door” kind of people. If I could have gone to Home Depot and bought a door off the shelf, I would have done that in a heartbeat. Because our home is older our door measurements are not standard though, so we needed a custom door built. When we sat down with Dennis the first time, we opened the catalog and I pointed to a door that I liked. He told me that since this is a big purchase I should go home and look through the catalog and make sure before I pulled the trigger. I explained to him that our front door is leaking water every time it rains and that this is kind of urgent for us. And I loved the door I had picked. He wouldn’t place the order until we thought about it for a night though, and since this was a Friday we had to wait until Monday to call Dennis and place the order. At that time, he told us he was putting in the order and I asked him to read back the measurements to me so I could verify they were correct. He read back completely wrong measurements, and I corrected him. There I was, all proud that I had caught that mistake before it became a major issue. How naive of me -it spiraled into a nightmare that is only now ending. Overall this has been a horrible and stressful experience. Our door people are here right now, installing the new door, so fingers crossed nothing else goes awry.

reviews.text:
If I could give zero stars, I would. I ordered custom doors from Resdoor and worked directly with Oliver, who assured me they could deliver exactly what I needed. I specifically told him I did not need a frame, but he insisted the frame was included and encouraged me to take it anyway.

On delivery day, no one called to provide a time or confirm they were coming—they just left the doors on my porch without any notice. Since I didn’t need the frame, I removed and disposed of it. When I went to install the doors, I realized they were standard size—not the custom size I ordered.

I contacted Oliver the next day, and instead of being helpful, he was incredibly rude and condescending—acting as if I had never ordered custom doors in the first place. After a lot of back and forth, he finally admitted he made a mistake and said the doors could be picked up the next day, but only if I still had the frame. He already knew I didn’t, yet used that as an excuse to refuse a return.

Any time I tried to speak with a manager, Oliver would answer and claim no one was available. Eventually, someone did come to pick up the doors (again with no prior notice), and when I told them I didn’t have the frame, they said it wasn’t needed.

Two days later, Oliver called saying they couldn’t do anything without the frame—contradicting what the drivers had told me. He then claimed the new doors would be made according to the photos and measurements I had sent. After not hearing back for a while, they again dropped the doors on my porch without notice—and the new set was still wrong.

Do not do business with this company. The customer service is extremely unprofessional, and they clearly don’t value their clients. If you do choose to work with them, get everything in writing, because their word means nothing. I wish I had listened to the other reviews—this has been nothing short of a nightmare.

reviews.text:
I called them out because the spring on the door came loose from the wall and lost tension.   This was due to the previous install not actually being bolted to the frame of the garage.

The tech started explaining how it needed to have everything replaced to be safe.   I pointed out that everything was still intact and not damaged so he changed what needed to be fixed.   I pointed out that the things he said were broken were fine so he started replacing the bolt and tensioning the spring.   After starting he stopped and told me he needed to replace the cable drums.   (A $5 part at home depot)  he quoted $125 each and $500 in labor.  Plus another $300 to tension the spring.   I understand a small mark up on parts, but from 5 to 125 is extreme.

I told him I couldn't pay $100 for the work so he said he won't fix anything and I owe him $185 for the diagnosis and the 2 $1 bolts he installed.   I told him exactly what was wrong when he showed up.   He didn't do a diagnosis.   This is extortion, not a business.

When I went to pay they didn't take card and only took cash or zelle.    This isn't a real business.

Stay away!   Call anyone else but these people.

reviews.text:
Like James Hemenway, I called the Overhead Door Company as my top panel support beam had become compromised.  I initially thought I needed that replaced.  The OHDC stated "No!" Everything was compromised and I needed at a minimum to replace the entire top panel for a sum of $1,602.10 (OTD).

"Trust but verify!"  Called a couple other garage door companies who stated, "Of COURSE we can replace that top panel brace!  Easy Peasy!  $260 later, my garage door if fixed, with a THREE-YEAR WARRANTY!!!

FTR, I "Googled" what an ENTIRE Garage door replacement would be and it would have been CHEAPER!

I'll close with, "Caveat emptor!!!".

Mammoth did an excellent job on our new fence. Matt was great to work with in the sales process, he was timely, open, friendly and extremely helpful. We ended up going with Mammoth due to the fact that the quality with steel posts would last longer than standard wood posts. Matt was honest from the beginning about the process they go through, going into details about how and WHY they install the fence the way they do. Prices were very competitive with a standard fence as well, and with the comparison, it was a no-brainer to go with the more solid option.

Day of install, Hugo and his team arrived promptly when we were told they would, were friendly and respectful of our space. They took the extra time to make sure the fence was perfect, and I will say it is just that, perfect.

Next time I'm in need, or someone asks for a reference, I'll be referring Mammoth for the excellent work they do.

reviews.text:
After getting quotes from several fencing companies, we found ourselves coming right back to Mammoth Fencing. We had actually met with them over a year ago, but had to put the project on hold while we focused on other priorities. When we reached back out, Taylor not only remembered me, but also remembered our project. That level of personal service really stood out.

As we explored different fencing materials, Taylor took the time to thoroughly explain the pros and cons of each option without ever making us feel pressured. His knowledge and patience gave us complete confidence that we were making the right decision by choosing Mammoth.

The installation was equally impressive. They fenced our large backyard on Lake Norman in just one day. The crew was professional, efficient, and incredibly respectful of our property. They worked so quietly that we barely knew they were there, cleaned everything up afterward, and took great care to preserve our existing plants and small garden along the fence line.

We couldn't be happier with the finished product. The quality of the work and the customer service exceeded our expectations. I highly recommend Mammoth Fencing and will absolutely be using them again as we fence our other properties.
