reviews.text: We had Chase and his crew install 375' of fence around our property for the dogs.  I received 4 quotes and ultimately decided to go with Lake Norman Fence based on Chase making good suggestions on the best route.  We were not following property line exactly and had a couple routes to go.  He suggested the hardest route through the woods and we couldn't be happier.  His quote did come in a little higher than the others, but once we discussed this it was based on them including TruClose hinges and Magna locks on the 3 gates we added.  Others didn't mention this option but Chase always considers this a standard feature, but we could have removed if we wanted.  We are very pleased with these two added items that we didn't originally plan on.  At the time of install, the crew walked every foot of the install path with me and went over every detail (door swing inside, hinge location, etc) and everything was done exactly as we discussed.  I believe the total install was completed in about 6 hours.

Chase Foley met me at our new home to discuss parameters. We needed a HOA compliant fence to safely secure two small dogs. Chase answered all of my questions and provided information about a double-picket fencing which was the best choice for our yard. Chase emailed a proposed fence diagram with a reasonable estimate. We submitted his diagram directly to our HOA. The project was quickly HOA approved. Lake Norman Fence promptly scheduled installation, arrived on time and did a great job. I would not hesitate to recommend their company.

Could not be any happier with our experience with Lake Norman Fence! From initial contact with Chase thru installation with the crew, everyone was incredibly professional!  So glad to have chosen Lake Norman Fence.
Although our fence project took an unexpected turn right before our first installation date, which we cancelled after signing the contract, Chase had no issue with refunding our deposit. A few months later we decided to move forward with our original plans of having our backyard fenced.  Lake Norman Fence would be the ONLY contractor we called.  Chase came back out to our property, remeasured, helped with a few design elements and quoted us the same pricing as our first install months prior. We know that prices fluctuate and let Chase know we would not have an issue with a price increase, but he chose to keep the cost as our original bid. THANK YOU!! (that meant ALOT to us!)
Our fence project looks FANTASTIC!

reviews.text:
Pro: I was highly recommended to Premier Fence by a competitor fence company since they could not install my fence the week requested.  His feedback was so positive about Brian w Premier that I called for an estimate. I was looking to connect to my neighbors fence.
The day I scheduled my online appointment for an estimate, Brian came to measure within 48 hours. Shortly after, I was sent an estimate via email. There was no pressure, sales pitch, or anyone trying to convince me to purchase.
Con: Once I decided to  choose their company, the rain seemed to pour every day except the weekends. They don't work on Saturday.
They were able to get my fence installed in time and in one day!  I was one happy customer. Communication was great throughout the entire process.
Price...eh.. you could probably find someone  a little cheaper, but will the overall quality and commitment  to the customer be the same?

reviews.text:
My husband and I were looking to get a 5' tall black aluminum fence in our yard for our 125 lb. Cane Corso so he can play in the yard. After reviewing 4 difference fence companies and getting quotes from each, we ultimately decided Stand Strong Fencing to be the best opportunity to get what we wanted accomplished. This was due to the fact that not only was the price lower than the competition for the same, if not better, product, but also because of the efficiency at which they communicated. I was asking questions at all times of the day and it never took longer than an hour for a response, even later into the evening. I greatly value constant communication and they did not disappoint. Also the organization of their team was beyond reproach. We were able to approve the quote online which made it quick and efficient and EASY.

For the installation, they immediately gave us a date to which it would be installed and kept checking in on us between the approval of the quote and the day of installation. The day it was actually installed, they communicated constantly about arrival times for materials and crew and any updates. Even when the materials were delayed, the owner called personally to inform us of the situation, which was very honest. The crew still showed up early to prep the area that way the installation was smooth. When the materials finally got there, my husband informed me that they were quick, left little to no mess, and were much quieter than expected.

We informed them after install that the locks that were already on the fence were not the original lock mechanisms discussed. The owner assured us that this would be fixed at no cost to us at it was previously discussed for our project. He would not even accept our final payment until the locks and our project were fully complete. He came out within a few days and replaced the locks and provided multiple sets of keys (which was great).

Stand Strong Fencing was very professional and we would 100% recommend their services to anyone looking at getting fencing for their properties!

Resifence was great to work with!  We had a fence uprooted during one of last year's storms.  John was super responsive, competitively priced, and quick to get the repair done.  Not only that but I threw him a last minute request, and he handled that in the same day without batting an eye.

I called numerous people to try and fix our fence.  They either never responded or the job was too small and they over priced it.  Luckily I happened to see John's truck one day and I am glad I called!  It has been over 6 months (man time flies) and the repairs are still rocking!

Going forward, Resifence will be the only call!

reviews.text:
DogWatch of Charlotte was an absolute pleasure to work with!

Lee and his team did an immaculate installation at my home, and their pricing was very reasonable — I was expecting it to cost twice as much as it did!

If you're considering a DIY hidden fence installation, do yourself a favor and call Lee first.

Two years before hiring DogWatch, I installed a major brand’s underground fence myself, and I had issues with it constantly. The loop would regularly go out for no reason, and after every heavy rain, it was almost guaranteed to fail until the ground dried out. I spent two years tracing the line, looking for breaks, and redoing spices before I finally called DogWatch.

Lee is incredibly knowledgeable and can answer any questions you may have. Steven and his crew installed one continuous loop of wire — meaning I'll never have to worry about shorts from bad splices again. They were also extremely careful during the installation: they buried the wire cleanly without tearing up my yard, and after using a hand tamper along the line, I couldn’t even tell where they had buried it earlier that day. They also took great care to locate and avoid cutting existing lines (fiber, coax, etc.), which I really appreciated.

The installation into my garage looks better than anything I could have done myself. They used conduit on the exterior so there’s no exposed wire hanging outside the house, and the interior setup looks immaculate. I was especially impressed with the precision of the hole they drilled to pull the wire through — it looks far more professional than anything I’ve seen from fiber installation technicians.

My Golden Retriever was already trained on a hidden fence and quickly adapted to his new DogWatch boundary. The DogWatch system itself is far superior to any in-store or online solution I’ve used. With my previous fence, there was a delay — the collar would beep when my dog entered the boundary zone, but he had about three seconds to retreat before receiving a correction. In contrast, the DogWatch collar is much smarter: it knows exactly which side of the boundary he’s on, only gives an audible warning when he enters the barrier, and only issues a correction if he actually crosses the line. Because of that, my dog has yet to be corrected — he immediately turns back when he hears the warning tone.

DogWatch fencing is, without a doubt, the best hidden fence solution I’ve seen, and DogWatch of Charlotte is a fantastic company to work with.

I would have absolutely no reservations recommending Lee and his crew to anyone.

reviews.text: We built and moved into a new house and in a subdivision that has pretty strict compliance requirements for home improvements including fences. Since I had never added a fence to a yard before, I needed all the help I could find. I ran across Discount Fence Direct in my online search for the right fence and found  their website was exactly what I was looking for to help me plan the fence. Their website provides a very logical and progressive tool to help scope out our fence. In addition, after you've finished with the web tool, Discount Fence Direct provides direct and verbal support to help finalize the order. I had many, many questions and  Megan and Jennifer from Discount Fence Direct went above and beyond their call to ensure I had all the answers to questions I knew to ask as well as many technical questions that I had not yet thought of ("how do I allow for a 40-degree turn on a 30-degree slop in the fence-line on an abnormal lot shape?"). They provide a quality solution fence that looks great,  outstanding customer service, and saved me a lot of money in the process.  I highly recommend Discount Fence Direct.

We had our screened porch completed by Carolina Fence and Screen, and we couldn’t be happier with the result. The workmanship was excellent, the team was professional, and the entire process was smooth from start to finish. The porch turned out beautiful and has already become one of our favorite spaces in the house.

What gave us even more confidence in hiring them again is that they also installed our fence about three years ago. The fence still looks great and has held up extremely well over time, which speaks to the quality of their work.

It’s not often that you find a contractor you trust enough to hire for multiple projects, but they have consistently delivered great results for us. We highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality work, reliability, and a team that truly cares about the finished product.

reviews.text:
I had an absolutely amazing experience with Felix and his team. They came out, measured, and installed my fence all in one day, and the final results looks incredible. The craftsmanship and professionalism were outstanding from start to finish.
I forgot to mention to Felix that I had an irrigation system in the yard. When I got home and checked everything, I realized part of the irrigation system had been covered by the fence. Naturally, I was concerned and assumed I would eventually have to pay to get it repaired myself. I explained the situation to Alex, and without hesitation, he volunteered to fix the irrigation issue at no additional cost.

What truly impressed me was Felix, integrity and commitment to do with the right thing. He even asked me to hold onto $1000 because he wanted me to know his word was solid and then he would absolutely return the next day to make it right. Sure, enough, early the next morning, his crew arrived, removed part of the fence, repaired the irrigation system, and then reinstall the fence perfectly all at no extra charge.

It is rare to meet someone who is genuinely stands behind their work and honors their word the way Felix does. I am beyond grateful for the kindness, honesty, and professionalism show throughout this entire experience. I would recommend Felix and his crew thousand times over. If you want a beautiful fence install by someone with true integrity and a strong code of honor, Felix is your guy.

Thank you again Felix many blessings to you and your team!

reviews.text:
I could not have asked for a better experience, from start to finish, replacing my fence.  When I first reached out to get a quote the only fence company I contacted that replied within 24h was David S Fence.  Making an appt to come to walk the yard and measure was quick and accommodated my work schedule.  No one else was as responsive, helpful in deciding what fence to go with AND all for a great price.  Once I decided to move ahead we agreed on a date and a crew was here, right on time today.  They removed the old fence, replaced it with a gorgeous, sturdy, well constructed new fence with 3 gates and beautiful hardware. I could not be happier with the new fence.  They were even careful with the invisible fence that sat on top of my old fence and replaced it on top of the new one.  The crew cleaned everything up and when we did the walk through at the end I again was tested with the utmost professionalism and integrity.
I have to agree with other reviews,  “What impressed us most was how far they went above and beyond to make sure every detail was right” and “ heavy duty hardware, are all standard. If you need any fencing at all this is the company to choose. ”.  I too was so impressed by this. I am so glad I found David S Fence.   And so is my dog!

It’s rare to find a company that delivers both quality work and a genuinely great customer experience, but Superior Fence exceeded expectations in every way. reviews.text:
I had a fence installed this past Thursday. While the quality of the installation looks great, the crew was unfortunately one post short of completing the project.

I was initially informed they would return Friday around 3:00 PM to finish. However, at that time, I received a call stating they were running late and would arrive either later that evening or on Saturday. As of Saturday afternoon, after having to reach out myself for an update, I received a text message indicating the completion has now been pushed to Monday.

While the workmanship appears solid, the lack of proactive communication and the multiple scheduling delays regarding the final piece of the project have been disappointing.

reviews.text:
First, QC is a just sales company, they don’t build anything. I thought I was hiring an established construction company. You may get a professional and experienced crew or you may get a couple guys in an unmarked van.  The same crews work for different companies also. You could call 3 different companies and get the same people.

We paid almost $11k for a 390ft fence and demo of an old fence.  I expected better quality and better consistency. Some gaps under the fence sections were as much as 5 inches and some sections were flat on the ground. The gates are awful - rough cut ends exposed and ugly boards used. They had to cover the double gate with pickets on the the back side to cover the work (when I brought it to their attention one of the guys said “yeah, I saw that” but he clearly wasn’t going to do anything had I not asked).

The crew of 2 that we had were friendly but clearly had no interest in detail work and fixing obvious mistakes. I expected more for what we paid.  Crraftsmanship is not what it used to be.

reviews.text:
We recently had our fence installed, and the finished product is absolutely outstanding. The craftsmanship is top-notch, and it's obvious this company knows how to build a quality fence.

The process started off great. Andrew handled the quote and was timely, professional, knowledgeable, and friendly. He answered all of our questions and made the decision process easy. We did have about an eight week wait for installation, but that seemed to be a result of how busy they are, which is understandable.

Installation day was where the experience became a little mixed. We were told the crew would arrive between 8:30 and 9:30 a.m., but they didn't get there until around noon. Delays happen, and that wasn't really the issue. The frustrating part was receiving repeated updates every 30 minutes saying they would be there in "20 minutes." I would have much preferred a realistic estimate instead of constantly moving the goalposts.

When the crew arrived, the crew leader asked if I could order pizza for the team and that they would reimburse me. It wasn't a huge deal, but it felt unprofessional, especially since it was presented as a way to save time.

There were also some process issues. The crew leader struggled with the iPad used for the pre-installation checklist and had me helping him scroll through tasks that really should have been completed before arriving on site. Even more concerning, we didn't actually complete the pre-installation checklist until after the fence was finished, and I was asked to approve items such as the "good side" of the fence, gate swing direction, and other decisions that had never been discussed beforehand.

At the end of the first day, I was told the crew would return the next morning to finish the job. At 8:00 a.m. on Saturday, I was woken up by a knock at the door from the installer, who came only to tell me they wouldn't be working because of the rain. A quick text or phone call would have accomplished the same thing without waking us up.

That said, I really appreciated that the director and crew manager came out in person to apologize. That level of accountability went a long way toward making things right and showed they genuinely care about their customers' experience.

In the end, I would recommend this company. Their installers are world-class fence builders. They completed an incredible amount of work, roughly 15 hours over two days, and the finished fence exceeded our expectations. I do think there's an opportunity to improve communication, professionalism, and adherence to the installation process. If those customer experience details matched the quality of the craftsmanship, this would easily be a flawless five-star experience.

At 8:00 a.m. on Saturday, I was woken up by a knock at the door from the installer, who came only to tell me they wouldn't be working because of the rain. A quick text or phone call would have accomplished the same thing without waking us up.

That said, I really appreciated that the director and crew manager came out in person to apologize. That level of accountability went a long way toward making things right and showed they genuinely care about their customers' experience.

In the end, I would recommend this company. Their installers are world-class fence builders. They completed an incredible amount of work, roughly 15 hours over two days, and the finished fence exceeded our expectations. I do think there's an opportunity to improve communication, professionalism, and adherence to the installation process. If those customer experience details matched the quality of the craftsmanship, this would easily be a flawless five-star experience.

reviews.text:
Review

This is going to a longer review because a few sentences cannot accurately describe the care, quality and customer service that QC Fence provides! From start to finish, they were absolutely incredible and I am so thankful we chose them to demolish our old chain link and install a 6 foot vinyl privacy fence.

From initial consult, Chase provided excellent service. He was on time and spent every bit of 30 mins on our property, explaining how the process would work. He answered every single one of my questions without hesitation and with complete confidence in his materials and team. He was even answering questions before I could ask them. The attention to detail and willingness to answer all my concerns is ultimately what made me decide to move forward with QC Fence.

They called 811 on our behalf and received clearance to continue demolish and construction. They were very flexible to our needs and work schedule, so we nailed down a date of Feb 5-6.

Trevor and his team mate were very clear about the process when they arrived to start work. Day 1 was removal of the old chain link and setting posts! Which they ended up staying well after 5pm to make it happen.

The following day, they began construction the panels and I had some concerns about how high they were off the ground. We have dogs/puppies and I was concerned about them getting under the fence. Trevor was so kind and took several minutes to explain to me that the posts were not in their final position and that once the panels were installed, they would go to each post individually and drive them further into the ground.

To further complicate this project, we wanted to fence around a complete eye sore that was a public utility/sewer station. However, 811 did not mark these lines, so through zero fault of their own, the line was hit. Trevor immediately informed me and he informed the QC Fence office.

I am explaining this part of the process not to discourage future clients, but to actually ENCOURAGE. Because this is where their customer service and pride in their work really stood out. From the moment this line was struck, Megan worked with me all day long to figure out who this utility belonged to. She was on the phones the entire day, and well after 5pm, to make sure this line was fixed properly and didn’t endanger my pets. Ultimately, the line was fixed at 9pm that evening, and we owe that to Megan an QC Fence!

The following week, Megan spent every day checking in with me, calling the utility company herself and providing updates on when they could come out to mark. Our property was finally marked correctly on a Friday at 3 pm. Under normal circumstances, I would assume that a contractor would complete work the following week. Not QC Fence. Trevor and his teammate were on my property within an hour to discuss options to work around the lines and our fence was completed by 5:30.

And the most remarkable part of this process in my eyes, was that QC Fence never once asked for the final payment or any sum of money until the following Monday. They never once hounded me about money. They stood by their mission and didn’t request payment until the project was completed to my satisfaction. And further more, Megan drove out of her way to pick up our last payment.

I truly cannot express how wonderful this company and its associates are. Like any investment, we were concerned about spending the money based on reviews and good faith. But these wonderful people provided us with peace of mind every step of this process. My husband, myself, and our 5 dogs are forever grateful for this incredible group of people. There will be no other phone call when we need more fencing solutions.

Thank you Chase, Megan, Trevor and the rest of the QC Fence Team!

reviews.text:
From start to finish, Justin was incredible to work with, and we are already planning to hire JG Outdoor again for future projects. Taking on an underground pool and deck project can be stressful, especially after hearing so many horror stories about contractors, but from the very beginning Justin and his crew gave us complete confidence that we were in good hands.

Our project had a lot of moving parts, including land surveys, locating the septic tank and well, and adjusting for other issues on the property. We even had to completely redesign part of the project once we discovered where the septic system was located. Through every change, Justin was patient, kind, responsive, and easy to work with. I never had to wonder what was going on because anytime I had a question, he got back to me right away.

Even with weather delays from the big snowstorm this year, Justin and his crew completed our full pool and deck project in just six weeks, which was incredibly impressive. His team was always polite, hardworking, and respectful. They cleaned up at the end of each day, showed up ready to work, and worked hard from morning until evening.

What stood out most was how understanding Justin was when my husband and I made a few on-the-spot design changes during construction. I never felt uncomfortable bringing something to his attention because he truly wanted us to love the final result. He and his team were clearly committed to making sure we ended up with the backyard oasis we had envisioned.

I cannot recommend JG Outdoor highly enough. If you are looking for a contractor who is trustworthy, responsive, professional, and genuinely cares about the quality of their work and their customers’ happiness, Justin and his team are the ones to call.

reviews.text: I highly recommend MK Fencing for fence installation and repairs. From the initial quote to the finished product, they were professional, on time, clean and reasonably priced. The original fencing company that installed our fence had cut a lot of corners, and MK Fencing caught those errors when they came by to inspect our fence to provide a quote. They replaced weak posts with strong gate posts to adequately support the weight of our gate, added concrete to leaning posts, repaired all the pickets and rails that were damaged by deer, and replaced a large section of our fence that was taken down by a tree. After they completed the work as agreed, I realized I overlooked a bent picket. I asked them for a quote to replace that single picket, and they offered to come back to my home to replace it for free! It is so rare to find honest, reliable contractors with good work ethic and does high-quality work. I highly recommend them for any fencing needs.

reviews.text: Had a great beginning with Luke! He did a great job explaining everything and going over all possible choices of fence of my selection. Sold me on the customer communication and the quality and materials used. After all was finalized this is where it started going down hill. Getting ahold of Conner, my project manager was nearly impossible. Left VM and TXT. Half the time I didnt get a response. Even had a dated scheduled for install without my approval, for I was out of town. Fast forward to install day. Email describes, works will be there between 8-930am and I will not need to be there the whole day. Crew did not show up until 11:30, where we quickly went over things for the fence then they left again for another hour. Most of my day was missed at work. Later that day before I left, I asked the crew what time I should expect to see them the next day. Response was 8-930 again. Crew didn't not show up until 10:30. Finally fence was completed, looks amazing. Good quality of materials used. Did notice 2 weeks after install, the wooden fence gate sticks out (not flush), and a fairly large gap at gate. Contacted Tammy from the care package, as she actually responds to my calls and emails. I sent her photos and she said she would sent to Connor (project manager) and that I should give conner a call. I call conner a couple times and left VM and even a TXT. Still no response from conner. I filled out a warranty claim a week ago and have heard nothing on the matter. Attempt calling conner again.... no response. Dandale provides a good quality fence. The communication needs work.

reviews.text:
Could have been 5 stars. The crew seemed to be doing a good job when Austin showed up in the afternoon and, with unexplained attitude, informed me that his crew would not do something simple that was agreed to before the job started. Simply put some tar that I already provided on the top of each post. When I told him that Chase and I had an agreement, Austin said he didn't care and then told me that he was the company boss and that Chase worked for HIM. That turned out to be a lie. I went out back a short time later to see the progress, and Austin walked up and said I was "running (my) mouth" to his crew. I said, "Excuse me?" He doubled down, and I told him to get off my property. He told the crew to stop work and leave. I told him the crew was welcome to finish the job, but he said if he was leaving he was taking the crew with him. I contacted Chase, who'd already just heard from Austin, and we had a conversation during which he apologized for the attitude and unprofessionalism and said he ordered Austin off my property and told the crew to finish, though what had been good vibes about having a new fence were completely gone. He promised to deal with Austin. I have no idea why Austin acted like that, especially since I'd been complementing the crew all day for the seeming good work so far. It was completely out of left field, and I was shocked. Honestly, I still am. Needless to say, what had been a positive experience today was ruined by Austin and left a very bad taste in my mouth.
NEXT DAY ADDENDUM: I finished today what was supposed to be done according to my agreement with Chase that Austin out of the blue refused to do even though I had already bought the materials. reviews.text:
Landmark installed a fence for us in 2018.   We were happy with the installation and had several years of trouble-free use.  Early in 2026 I noticed that one of the fence posts was leaning and the stone border next to it was collapsing into the ground.  I wasn't sure if Landmark's warranty would cover this, but I reached out to them and sent photos of the situation.   I ended up talking to Curt, who quickly agreed to send a someone to take care of it.  Robert came out a few days later to inspect and repair the fence.  He was genuinely interested in making sure everything was diagnosed and corrected.  He could have just made a quick fix to a damaged drainage pipe, straightened the post and reset it.  But he dug deeper, finding an additional issue which he repaired.

Everything is in good shape now and the fence looks great.  I am happy to deal with a company that stands behind their work.

reviews.text:
1 acre custom fence w/15 foot slide gate across our driveway. Deposit (half of job) was paid cash mid January, started mid February, finished mid March. I now know this was because they are inexperienced & he was worried about securing “big jobs with city of Rock Hill” & on business trip in Utah at fencing convention.

We cleared a nearly perfect line of sight on all sides but they did not mark corners nor follow. The measurements taken in comparison to our survey plat are vastly different on two sides even though this company said their digital measuring tool goes straight to their phone so no mishaps possible.

The front side of our fence is three rail wood with black chainlink, one side & back side are black chainlink & one side through woods is t-post & wire. His quote was aligned with his competition & his competition even quoted wood posts, concrete/wire versus t-post. We chose Brian based on the fact that gates were supposed to be their specialty area & to support a veteran.

The chain link is the only part that was done remotely correct minus some chainlink/tension wire placement being incorrect. The t-post side almost all wire was tacked into trees even after being asked not to & used huge pine as bracing corner post. All of this done to save them time & money to not use proper post or follow cleared line. He even tacked 2 foot of chainlink to our neighbors fence that my husband ask him to remove & build properly inside the pine tree with the cleared line. They just cut the chainlink tacked it to the pine tree & put a facial board to block. This side looks DIY at best & even other companies have looked at the work deeming it unprofessional.

The real frustration is that almost every board and post are cracked (some all the way through), chipped and warping. We can get over the large knots in the posts but quality control of their product is needed. He left us some wood when we mentioned this (basically his scrape). The gate posts were moved three times after setting. Now there are issues with it hitting the fence & getting stuck every time we open it and gaps in corners above our driveway. The welds on the gate are terrible, powder coating coming off & the aluminum posts are dinged up from moving/banging on them to fit the gate they built.

The wood quality is worse than any big box store & their cuts are poor. He said he uses 60lbs of concrete per post & fills back with dirt, this isn’t correct. Most of ours has 6-10 inches exposed & we have gaps in chainlink not touching the ground from improper placement between boards before screwing fence together. Brian said the grass growing up would help with these issues.

On his last day here he was extremely rude & frustrated that he couldn’t get the gate correct. I have multiple videos of them trying to make everything look presentable on the front with the gate since I complained about the work, he clearly is winging it the whole time. He said he didn’t know his guys built the fence so bulky (whatever that means). After getting it to a decent look he called me outside & I was like sure because we were ready to be finished with his incompetence. He never did final walk through of the finished product, wasn’t here when it was built & only helped with hanging gate since he said his guys didn’t know how. Once I said it looked okay he was like “welp you’re done I’ll send you final invoice.” Which he did with 100 dollar discount lol.

After much complaining via email because he would no longer return my texts, he gave a small discount for his mess on the t-post side. He told us to mail final payment to his P.O. Box which we did & informed him we would be sharing our experience. We are 10s of thousands of dollars into this job that is now costing us thousands more to fix and try to salvage. The t-post side has to be completely redone and we are doing what we can with sanding/wood filling and correctly stapling the chainlink to the 250ft on the front of our house. Truly a nightmare experience that I wouldn’t wish upon my enemies. *Photos attached for proof of review*

reviews.text:
I called Trinity Fence and Gate after my neighbor highly recommended them. I did a new pool not even thinking we had to do a fence  (a cost the pool company didn’t warn me about) mark the owner answered the phone the first time I called. He was very professional and helpful. We set appointment for the following day mark showed up 15 mins early (on time) dressed nice and really helped me out of a bind. He also educated me on the code for fences around pools. He gave me serval options and was very patient not pushy. Once I made the selections on what I wanted he then did me a quote on the spot within 15 mins. His quote was more than fair and was serval thousands less than the fencing guys the pool company recommended. We decided to move forward with Trinity fence and gate as I felt good about doing business with mark. We sign a proposal gave a deposit mark ordered materials within a week mark came with his crew and they knocked out our fence in two days (they made it look easy) I’m a really picky person when spending thousand on something. There wasn’t once thing that I could find I didn’t like. Mark actually found two things he didn’t like after I said it was perfect and fixed them anyways as he said he wouldn’t be happy with it. What a great experience and I would highly recommend Trinity fence and gate to anyone looking for a company that is honest has integrity and care for their customers.
Thank you mark you rock!

When contacted they take no responsibility for a terrible job done and instead I'm told could be wind damage. And on top of that I'm told how flimsy the fence is that kids can push out slats. What the hell did I pay 7700$ for? At this point it's clear companies like this in this country only want your money and don't really care to take care of their work. I really don't recommend them or going through Lowe's because both of them will bounce you to the other under the guise of a warranty. Quick to take money, but terrible when it comes to accountability.

reviews.text:
Brent, Amanda, and the team at BNB Fence did a great job installing my fence 1-1/2 years ago.  I called them recently to remove about 24’ of the original fence so I could do some yard work and remove two trees. They removed the fence and also put up a temporary fence so my dogs would not escape. They were patient and when I was ready a few months later, they came back out and added 35’ of new fencing and reinstalled the 24’ they removed.  This helped me reclaim some of my yard.   I could not be more pleased with the original install, new install and his whole team of installers.   They also did some repair work on another fence.
You always have options for fencing but why look any place else when you will be happy with BNB.

reviews.text: We hired National Rent a Fence -Charlotte to install a 950’ temporary fence around a commercial construction project in Greenville SC. The fence has blow down at least 4 times in the past month. I have made repeated calls and sent multiple emails to the sales person asking for her to please send a crew to secure the fence. The only reply I ever get is that they will get it taken care of sometime the following week, then they don’t show up. No one has ever followed up with me, I have initiated every email or phone call to the National Rent A Fence sales person.  I cannot recommend that anyone use this company. I don’t know if the lack of response from them is because this is a “small” project for them and not worth it to keep our business or if it is just a result of an unprofessional sales person who doesn’t care about her accounts but we will be using another vendor for our temporary construction fencing going forward.

Wow. Sometimes great service happens to you when you're not expecting anything and it surprises you so much that you sort of don't want to tell anyone about it because then the secret will be out and the next time you need some service they will be too busy to give you the surprisingly great service you got in the first place.
Working with Southlands Fence is just great, start to finish. Michael came out for an estimate (very reasonable), listened to our needs, and was patient with us as the project took longer than we thought it would. He tolerated our small changes to the project.
When it finally came time to install the new fencing, the Southlands crew was amazing. Gustavo and Julio arrived early and worked clear through the day and into the dark. The fence they installed is solid, straight, and strong.
And Southlands was willing to make some post-install adjustments as we figured out how best to live with the new fence and all of its latches and gates.
This new fence was a big project for us, and Southlands Fence was really easy to work with, very reasonably priced for a quality product, and did an excellent install. Thank you!

reviews.text: I used this business in order to install a fence on the side of my property in order to keep my children from venturing up and down a sloped hill. I was in contact with the owner for months while working through neighborhood restrictions. He came out and gave me the price. We both agreed on it. Do not use a business who tries to disguise their mistakes in the cost of the completion of the product. I would highly recommend finding another fencing company for your work. The work was subpar. reviews.text:
Experience was worse than explosive diarrhea in rush hour traffic.

Ordered material 10/12/2020.

Told 6-8 weeks for install

Followed up around week 10 - did not hear back

Followed up around week 11 - did not hear back

Followed up around week 12 - told unsure of when material was going to be delivered.

Followed up around week 14 - did not hear back

Followed up around week 16 - escalated to “manager” - offered roughly 2% credit for the delay and lack of communication. Was assured material would be delivered by 1/19

Week of 1/11-1/15 - randomly one day, I noticed spray painted lines all over the back yard. Utility marking. I was not made aware that utilities were going to be marked, that someone was going to be walking around my house, nothing.

1/19 - followed up late in the day because I hadn’t received an update. I was told “yup material came in and we’re installing Thursday.” Two day notice? Okay.

1/20 - I go to take my garbage out and the person who we worked with at this company to sign documents for the fence was in my back yard marking additional items. Again, no heads up, nothing.

1/21 - install day. Installers show up at about 8:20 and ask me if the material is there. No? Again, I know NOTHING about my fence because there has been hardly any communication. Materials show up around 8:45. Pretty much from that point on, issues arose. The irrigation lines were possibly in the way, the back line was diagonal and not straight (which was the estimators fault for no knowing how to measure). To fix it, they were going to make the fenced portion smaller than I wanted. After much discussion, we worked through those two issues. I was told the fence would be done this day. Well, much to my surprise, another over promise and under deliver. Another broken promise. Another lie. I was told the person that had the tools to build the gates was not able to come back out but they would be at my house to finish the install first thing on 1/22. We also discussed my dissatisfaction thus far and I was told they have heard their communication wasn’t great and they were working on it.

1/22 - were the installers here first thing? Take a guess. I emailed and called Brad. I was ignored. Apparently our conversation about communication really sunk in. I called the office and the estimator called back saying they’d be there at lunch time. Again, I was assured the fence would be completed today. Installers finally showed up after 1pm. By 4, they had successfully dug 2 holes. They come to the door, tell me there’s a problem. SHOCKER. They dug right where utilities were marked and said they couldn’t finish because the gate wasn’t big enough. Now we have to wait a THIRD day for our fence to be completed. As the installers were leaving for the day, I asked for Brad’s bosses information. They told me Brad was the OWNER of the company. I actually laughed.

1/23 - installers showed up on time. Took a few hours and the fence was finally complete.

I will also add that the first invoice was incomplete so I was sent another. The second invoice coincidentally left off part where they ask for reviews and list the sites. Thankfully I still had the original to tell everyone to stay away!

Everything looks great and the dogs love being able to run around. Just wish it was a better experience. Stay away from this company. The communication is dismal, the customer service is dreadful and the delay was deplorable.

Followed up around week 11 - did not hear back

Followed up around week 12 - told unsure of when material was going to be delivered.

Followed up around week 14 - did not hear back

Followed up around week 16 - escalated to “manager” - offered roughly 2% credit for the delay and lack of communication. Was assured material would be delivered by 1/19

Week of 1/11-1/15 - randomly one day, I noticed spray painted lines all over the back yard. Utility marking. I was not made aware that utilities were going to be marked, that someone was going to be walking around my house, nothing.

1/19 - followed up late in the day because I hadn’t received an update. I was told “yup material came in and we’re installing Thursday.” Two day notice? Okay.

1/20 - I go to take my garbage out and the person who we worked with at this company to sign documents for the fence was in my back yard marking additional items. Again, no heads up, nothing.

1/21 - install day. Installers show up at about 8:20 and ask me if the material is there. No? Again, I know NOTHING about my fence because there has been hardly any communication. Materials show up around 8:45. Pretty much from that point on, issues arose. The irrigation lines were possibly in the way, the back line was diagonal and not straight (which was the estimators fault for no knowing how to measure). To fix it, they were going to make the fenced portion smaller than I wanted. After much discussion, we worked through those two issues. I was told the fence would be done this day. Well, much to my surprise, another over promise and under deliver. Another broken promise. Another lie. I was told the person that had the tools to build the gates was not able to come back out but they would be at my house to finish the install first thing on 1/22. We also discussed my dissatisfaction thus far and I was told they have heard their communication wasn’t great and they were working on it.

1/22 - were the installers here first thing? Take a guess. I emailed and called Brad. I was ignored. Apparently our conversation about communication really sunk in. I called the office and the estimator called back saying they’d be there at lunch time. Again, I was assured the fence would be completed today. Installers finally showed up after 1pm. By 4, they had successfully dug 2 holes. They come to the door, tell me there’s a problem. SHOCKER. They dug right where utilities were marked and said they couldn’t finish because the gate wasn’t big enough. Now we have to wait a THIRD day for our fence to be completed. As the installers were leaving for the day, I asked for Brad’s bosses information. They told me Brad was the OWNER of the company. I actually laughed.

1/23 - installers showed up on time. Took a few hours and the fence was finally complete.

I will also add that the first invoice was incomplete so I was sent another. The second invoice coincidentally left off part where they ask for reviews and list the sites. Thankfully I still had the original to tell everyone to stay away!

Everything looks great and the dogs love being able to run around. Just wish it was a better experience. Stay away from this company. The communication is dismal, the customer service is dreadful and the delay was deplorable.

I recently hired BNB Fence Company to install an aluminum fence around our backyard, and I am absolutely thrilled with the results! From the very first consultation to the final installation, their team was professional, knowledgeable, and a pleasure to work with.

They located the exact aluminum fencing I had been seeking to match both the look of my home and the functionality I needed. The materials are clearly high quality, and the craftsmanship speaks for itself. It looks beautiful and adds a modern, upscale touch to my yard.

The crew at BNB was punctual, respectful of my property, and kept everything neat throughout the process. They completed the job on schedule, and their communication was excellent — I was never left wondering what was happening or when.

After the project was complete they sent me a handwritten letter of appreciation and followed up with me to make sure I was content with the final product — I was!

What really stood out to me was their attention to detail. They didn’t cut corners, and you can tell they take real pride in their work. The finished product is both sturdy and stylish — and I’ve already gotten compliments from neighbors!

If you're considering an aluminum fence or any type of fencing, I highly recommend BNB Fence Company. They truly went above and beyond to make sure I was satisfied. A+ service and results!

reviews.text:
Got our fence up in April 2021 and the wait time for the installation AND installation was suitable, no complaints there - at the time they would have had a 4-5 star review.

Less than 2 years later, the long term quality of the fence is poor. They have a 1 year warranty on their installation and just past 1 year the fence slides out of one of the posts any time there’s wind. They said they don’t even do repairs and outsource repairs to someone else in Charlotte.

That 1 year warranty should have told me all I needed - a fence that will last 1 year and then will promptly begin to fail, leaving the homeowner alone to pick up the pieces.

Pictures added on April 1, 2023 following overnight thunderstorm with wind. You don’t need to be in the business of fences to see that pieces that were too small were used.

reviews.text:
Why Sunrise Fence Should Be Your Only Choice for Fencing

When I contacted 15 fence contractors for quotes, only 6 bothered to respond, a clear sign that most companies in this industry lack basic customer service skills. While other contractors lose potential customers by insisting on time-consuming in-person visits, Sunrise Fence understands that modern homeowners value efficiency and responsiveness.

For my 240 sq ft wooden dog ear fence project, I received quotes ranging from $4,800 to $9,700, a staggering difference that shows how much contractors can vary in both pricing and value. Rather than simply choosing the cheapest option, I selected Sunrise Fence because they offered the perfect combination of competitive pricing and outstanding reputation across all social media platforms.

Here's what makes Sunrise Fence your best choice:

Transparent, Fair Pricing: Save even more with their cash payment option (avoiding the 3% credit card fee). Their straightforward payment terms: 50% deposit upfront, 50% upon completion shows that they're confident in their work.

Exceptional Customer Service: Maria at the front office provided professional, personable service that's rare in this industry. You might want to call Maria directly for the best deals and personalized attention that eliminates any middleman hassles.

Superior Craftsmanship: On-site supervisor Chino and his dedicated team operate with complete integrity and transparency, ensuring your project is done right the first time, every time.

Proven Track Record: Their consistently excellent ratings across all social media platforms speak volumes about their reliability and quality.

Don't waste time with unresponsive contractors or risk your investment with unreliable companies. Sunrise Fence consistently exceeds expectations and delivers results you can count on. Call Maria today. You'll be glad you chose the company that truly cares about your project and your satisfaction.

reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with the lack of professional integrity from this company. I had a custom gate installed a couple of years ago, and despite very light usage, the gate has already come off.
When I called for a repair, I was told it would cost $200 just to come out and install a new screw. Even worse, the company admitted that because the gate opens wide, "this will happen" and they won't guarantee that it won't fall off again.
If the design or location was structurally unsound for a wide-opening gate, they should have used their expertise to tell me that before the installation. Instead, they are now asking for $200 for a "fix" that they openly admit is a temporary band-aid.
I am more than willing to pay for a professional, permanent solution, but I refuse to pay $200 for a single screw and a "maybe" on a product they designed. If you want a gate that actually lasts—and a company that stands behind their work—look elsewhere. Worst customer service experience ever.

————
Thank you for your response, but I find it incredibly unprofessional that you are assuming I 'abused' or 'slammed' a gate that I have already told you I rarely even use.
As the experts, you should know that on a wide custom gate, gravity and leverage are the primary forces at play—not 'abuse.' If a gate is physically capable of opening to a point that causes it to fail, then the installation was flawed from day one. You never provided gate stops or informed me that the design you sold me was structurally incapable of handling its own range of motion.

reviews.text:
I purchased a 6 ft white vinyl privacy fence from Gaston Fence back in May. There was a total of 375 feet of fencing to complete. I ended up installing it myself and was successful due to the extreme patience/willingness to assist from these employees. It took me 2 months of nights and weekends so it isn't for the faint of heart. Thank you Serena and all who fielded my phone calls!

Pros:
-Great Customer service
-Accurate pricing and final quantity delivered (even down to the individual screws). There were 2 spare panels left at the end that I saved for spares.
-High quality hinges and hardware for the gates with the option to spring closed.
-Delivery was quick and the delivery driver was accommodating by precisely placing all of the materials where I needed them.

Cons:
-The custom graded gate leaves have sagged slightly over the last 5 months of use. I will likely install a strip of metal on the back of each gate leaf to restore it to it's original angle.
-Gate leaves were not 48 inches across (more like 44 inches) so the overall gate opening ended up less than 8 ft total. This makes putting a trailer through the opening more difficult. Not a defect, just a miscommunication on my part. I thought they would be 48 inches.

reviews.text: Absolutely a wonderful experience. Jason came out same day and answered all of our questions. We were really struggling to come up with a fence layout that would flow with our oddly shaped yard. He gave us his professional opinion and after seeing it laid out on paper we were very pleased! He got us over the estimate same day and with much surprise it was under my expected guesstimate. We went with the black chain link and the look does not disappoint! The installers were also amazing and worked hard and efficient! Within a day in a half our entire front yard and partial back yard was completely fenced in. reviews.text: Six years ago A-1 installed a 6 foot aluminum fence around my backyard.  A few weeks ago I called to get a quote on widening the gate to the back yard so it could be accessed by my truck and utility trailer.  I was told an estimator would call me back soon.  A week later I finally got a call.  I told him what I was needing and he said he would come the following week on Tuesday or Wednesday.  I've received no visit or a phone call since.  Normally I'd be "Okay, whatever," but I'm a previous customer.  I spent thousand of dollars with this company.  I would expect them to show their appreciation by providing quality and prompt customer service after the fact.  I was highly disappointed that since my gate was small job and not a new expensive one A-1 didn't think I was worth their time.  That being said, I called another local company and within 3 days I had an estimator out at my house and a quote.  I know everyone has a different experience but I can only suggest that you choose someone else.  Find a company that is hungry and eager for your business and is willing to work for it.

This is my experience with A-1 fencing. I called one day back in June or July I believe it was . 6 months after my father died and I had just recently gotten involved in his company since being clean off drugs . Needless to say my dad had passed , people in his front office were past the age of retirement and were giving me a year to find someone to replace them . I called A1 fencing ans they sent someone out. I began talking with the younger guy and he too had his dad pass away at the same time as mine and was relating to me all the changes he went through and was goingthrough. This gave me a sigh of relief becauze i felt he knew where i was coming from and that i was hoping he would understand and not take my situation. Any less important than the other guy or the next customer . My assistant/gf who was kept in charge of communication between me and them whilst working , scheduling drop off of tires , writing invoices, changing the tires, ordering the tires for stock the shop, taking road side  calls , and trying to plan for that . I was over whelmed and My shop looked a mess. I hired these guys to take a load of stress off of me and I did not get that . I paid $4000 for them to fix the fencing and in any part it needed . Especially the places where the barbed wire was broken or pulled down so it would help with security and the fence needed a tending to in different places due to just random things from over the years. I.E. a truck driver backing into the fence one time or where bolts had rusted and broke and let certain support pipes fall causing the fence to sag in a few places. the fence also was beginning to wash out from the rain and drainage . etc etc. I'll post the invoice aswell.. The main reason I called them was to fix and get my gates and fencing around the shop looking nice and secure. I was over being over whelmed with everyone like my dad's employees, anyone who come by the shop or anyone in my personal life swell as family and friends or acquaintance that was and were my dads persoabl friends aswell. reviews.text:
It’s unfortunate when you call a company twice for fence repair and was told to text pictures to two different numbers. Neither person responded to texts or callbacks. With the current economy, I would think a company would be glad to win someone’s business.
If this company looks at these reviews, here are some suggestions:
1. Whoever takes the call - ensure you intake customer’s name, phone number, address and an email address or submission form with options to upload photos.
2. Followup with customer’s within 24 hours, remember you have competitors.
3. The office should be ensuring a someone reached out either for a phone quote or on-site for efficiency.
4. Stay in front of potential customers (Phone/Text/Email) until they schedule or request not to be contacted.
5. If you’ve won a customer’s business, always have someone in leadership ensure client satisfaction.
6. Referrals are awesome, word of mouth advertising still works! Ask for a Google review. Create a referral gift card program to show appreciation.
When your business footprint is in an exploding area, let your company stand above the rest. If I research a business I will ask for someone by name if I read they did great work taking care of them. Just because the job was small, doesn’t mean that same person may own other businesses or properties they’d hire you for.

reviews.text: I was mostly pleased with the initial work. I did notice that boards were cut uneven in places, but I decided it was acceptable. The trouble began after we had slightly higher than usual winds. The gate had two sides but they only installed a bar to hold the gate in place on one of the two gate doors. For this reason, the wind was able to tear at the gate. It tore up the gate and the post it was attached to. I called to ask for it to be repaired. Even though I felt that the fence should have held up to wind, I agreed to pay for the repair. Even though I was paying, when the workers arrived they appeared to resent being asked to make the repair. I was confused by that. I can't say exactly what they were thinking but their behavior toward me was, in my opinion, unprofessional . After they left, I realized that they had not replaced all of the broken boards and the cut on the top of the gate was splintered and looked off center to me. But worse was that they cut the new gate about 2 1/2 inches shorter than the older gate right beside it so when the two gates were closed there was a 2 1/2 difference where the two gates met. In my opinion and the opinion of several friends and a neighbor, it looked really bad. I asked them to come back and fix it and when they did i felt their behavior was rude. They seemed hostile.They stated that they were there to do whatever would "make me happy so I wouldn't call them back out again in two weeks" I reported the interaction to Brent Spath and he never responded. I felt that the way they spoke to me and treated me was very unprofessional.and I would not recommend them.

reviews.text:
I was going to give Carolina Wood Fence, run by the son named Brent a 5 star review once his guy's returned and fixed the hole left under the sloping part of our fence that faced Norman Shores Drive.  After sending Brent pictures of the opening he called but refused to come out and look at it. He said he would send Mike out to fix it.
Since the house is being built, we've not moved in and Brent knew this. He nor Mike called to let me know when they would be out. So I wasn't there when Mike showed up. All Mike did was remove the good boards over the opening under the fence and replace with same size used pieces that are a different color. He then dug a hole in the yard and threw that dirt under the fence, leaving the hole in the yard.
I sent Brent a message with pictures showing what Mike had done. I told him if this was how he did repairs I would not be recommending him or giving a good review. I spent Over $8,000. for this fence to keep dogs in when we move in.Brent called me and was upset from the start. He accused me of being angry while I was trying to calm him down to let me talk. He accused my landscapers of breaking boards and gates, yet nothing was broken and Mike never replaced any broken boards. Brent REFUSED to come out and looked and placed the blame on everyone else. He believed his guy's over me, the customer who paid and who wanted him to come see for himself.  I was not at anytime yelling at Brent he was doing all the yelling and was very defensively. He was so mad he just hung up, not allowing me to speak.
NO WAY I RECOMMEND THIS COMPANY !!
Brent gets very angry and yells all the while saying he is a calm person because he's a Charlotte Fireman.
If Brent had just come out and looked and fixed it the way I asked, he would have gotten high recommendations from me. Brent instead chose to continually ask me how many fences had I ever put up???
When you're going to get paid big bucks, you would think Brent would do what the customer asks him to do for them.
PLEASE, DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY you'll  be sorry in the end.

reviews.text: Awful company!!!!! Mike, father of Brent and owner, is unprofessional and clearly has an issue with women. He was disrespectful and rude to me multiple times when discussing issues on their end with why my fence was not being completed properly. I was also told my fence would be completed Friday, then they didn’t have enough material or the right gate so then I was told it would be completed Tuesday or Wednesday by the latest and it is Wednesday and still is not completed. Mike acted like he didn’t care, nor did he call me to tell me the fence would be delayed further. They clearly are used to bad reviews because he even said ‘leave me a bad review or do whatever you want’ when I questioned why he hadn’t called the gate company yet to obtain an update concerning my fence. I wish I would have read the reviews. I was recommended this company by a friend and didn’t think I needed to look into the reviews. DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY - They do not follow through then treat you horribly for their mistakes. I could go on and on about how bad this whole situation has been and the amount of stress it has created for myself and family. I originally spoke with Brent, Mike’s son,  concerning the job and have yet to be able to get back ahold of him. He never came back out to get exact measurements of what I wanted and tried to use an old beat up gate they got from ‘their yard’ instead of getting me a new gate that I paid for and a specialized one due to being on a slant. I am shocked at how I have been treated through this process, as well as the lack of communication, professionalism and respect.

reviews.text: This fence project had its bumps in the road. We have a septic system with a leach field. I informed Brent of this but I don't think either of us thought it would be as big of a pain as it turned out to be. On day 1 the team working on the fence ended up busting one of the lines. Not their fault, just doing their job. Work was halted. I had plumbers come out and give estimates that were astronomical. I worked closely with Michael, the owner, and he made it right. The respect and authenticity he showed towards me and his company was much appreciated. Fast forward a month we have a fence that the team had to hand dig holes for that looks GREAT! Even with the unexpected delay I would recommend these guys any day! This is also our second time using them and if we ever need fence work again, it will not be the last!

reviews.text: Stay away from this company unless you want to spend good money for a fence that will fall apart in less than 3 years.  I contacted the company to complain about the poor quality of their product.  I was told they do not warranty their wood.  I sent them the below photos plus others and requested repairs.  I was quoted a price of $350.00 to replace 8 post caps only.  These caps retail for about $10.00 which means they probably get them for about $5.00.  When I complained about the price, they said the rest was for labor.  That's approximately $310.00 for someone to come to the house and sit 8 caps on top of the posts!!  And I live in the same town a very short distance away!! This quote does not include replacing the top board that is so badly warped it pulled up and the nails are showing, the gate that has shrunk so much it no longer latches but swings in the wind, and the other gate that has to be slammed to close due to being so badly warped.   I also have to mention that a name brand wood preservative was used shortly after the fence was constructed.  This company does not stand by their work (or material) and does not even deserve 1 star.  I hope anyone looking to hire them takes the time to read the reviews and runs in the other direction.

I rarely write reviews, but this fence company truly deserves it. They installed my fence about three years ago, and the quality of their work has held up beautifully. Recently, I noticed a small issue and reached out, not expecting much given how long it had been. To my surprise, they responded immediately and came out to fix it without hesitation.
That level of commitment is almost unheard of these days. Their craftsmanship was excellent from the start, but what really sets them apart is their integrity and customer care long after the job is done. It’s clear they stand behind their work and genuinely value their customers.
If you want a company that does the job right and continues to show up for you years down the road, this is the one. Highly recommend.

reviews.text: It's unfortunate I compose this message without knowing how they operate if they are hired. When we first contacted this company in Dec. 2021, the surveyor went to our home and took measurements. He advised that the estimate will be emailed within 24 - 48 hours. We did not receive the estimate within that timeframe. I communicated with the surveyor, and it was emailed. We decided not to purchase the fence due to the cost. A few changes transpired and we decided to communicate with this company again to have the surveyor take measurements. I replied to the email and did not receive a response. My wife went to their office in-person and spoke with a woman who stated that the surveyor could possibly be at our home that day or he would contact me. They never followed up and I emailed again. They responded with an apology, and I replied to inquire when they can send someone out. They never replied and I called their office and left a voice message. Still, no response or call back. I gave this company numerous opportunities and it's evident that they are too busy, or simply pick and choose jobs that's financially beneficial. I do not recommend this company due to the lack of communication. I will be looking elsewhere to find another company that will be responsive and have respect for their prospective customer.

reviews.text:
This company operates heavy machinery during all hours of the night in Cobb County, Georgia, despite having the police called on them consistently. I just drove over to speak with them and was told “there is nothing we can do. We have to work.” Interestingly enough they packed up and left immediately after I told them I called the police yet again.

These are photos of this company operating heavy machinery at 4:05 am on May 3, 5:43 am on May 21, and 2:53 am on May 22, directly violating Cobb County’s noise ordinances:

“The operation of any set, instrument, phonograph, machine or device between the hours of 11:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m. in a manner as to be plainly audible at a distance of 50 feet from the device if outdoors, or 50 feet from the building, structure or vehicle in which it is located shall be prima facie evidence of a violation of this article.”

reviews.text: Charlotte Fence Builders has been proven to be a company of professionalism and integrity. We brought them in on a large commercial project that required to be done quite quickly, due to some unforeseen difficulties and Charlotte Fence Builders stepped in, took on this project,  and completed the project very efficiently allowing us to open for business as needed. I was very impressed with their diligence, as they knew of the importance to us in getting this fence project finished to allow us to open our business.   Even though the supply chain has proven to be challenging, Charlotte Fence Builders moved rapidly to get materials needed and installed for us.  Jennifer in the office is responsive and communicated well with the progress of the project.   I worked with Matt mostly with the installation of the electric gate. He has been so responsive and very helpful during the installation as well as with a most recent service call we needed. In addition, the installation crew was hard-working and a pleasure to work with.   I highly recommend Charlotte Fence Builders, I continue to refer them to others and  use them on all our construction projects!  Thank you Charlotte Fence Builders Team!!

reviews.text:
I’m a state lic. General Contractor and a carpenter by trade. Building my own fence would be very easy, however, every trade has their tricks of the trade so I always look to the specialized teams.
I got a quote from another company, price was fine but I just had a gut instinct he would not be the right fit for me. Not one for getting lots of prices, I figured I would check Matthews Fencing. After all they have a location and been there forever, what do I have to lose.
I reached out over the weekend and got a response within 24 hours. Rough budget was provided, and we set up an appointment to come out and measure. The rep arrived on time and even called 30 minutes out.
Looked over and measured and said he would get a quote back that day…. And he did. Price was comparable but at that point, I already made up my mind, I would be going with Matthews Fencing. I stopped in to provide my deposit and meet the owner, we made a few up-grades and got on the schedule.
Locating service came out and I was told this would be the week, sure enough, today was the day.
The installer and guys with him couldn’t have been nicer. The fence is amazing, and they took down the old one and installed the new one, all in one day. The quality is second to none and I’m likely going to get them back to replace a back section that was not as bad as the rest, but the new looks so good, why not. I’ll also be having them look at my daughter’s house.
Price was extremely fair, the quality of materials and installation fantastic, and dealing with Matthews Fence couldn’t have been any easier.

reviews.text: Took 3 weeks for Jay to come out. Text/called every day during those 3 wks saying he would be out the next day to complete my repair. At that point he had been nice and seemed reasonably priced, so I stayed flexible. The day he actually completed the repair, he didn’t have the correct replacement parts that he agreed to install (said he’d have to order them), so I settled for an alternative that he recommended. Once he was finished with my job, he THEN mentions the price had changed (it now was more than double the orig amt) and the alternate solution that he ended up installing didn’t turn out like I expected (it is effective for the most part but looks half-ass). If I had known he was going to charge me over $1k for this job, I would have expected better quality of service and craftsmanship, as well as the correct replacement part I asked for. Get a detailed quote from him in writing and don’t expect him to take proper measures. He knew right before I paid him how upset I was for the lack of transparency on his pricing and didn’t care to make it right. He also scratched up my flooring with his ladder and didn’t take ownership of that either.

reviews.text:
I had one of the scariest moments of my life today, and this towing company showed up when I needed help the most.
I was driving to the hospital because I was having chest pain. My car suddenly froze in the middle of the highway. I was scared and stressed. I called them, and they answered right away. The person on the phone spoke calmly and treated me with respect.
They arrived fast. No delay. No confusion. They handled everything with care and professionalism.
The team was polite, patient, and kind. They made sure my car was safely towed to Walmart Auto Center. On top of that, they dropped me off at the emergency hospital so I could get medical help quickly. That meant more to me than they know.
In a moment when I felt helpless, they stepped in and took control of the situation. They did not treat it like a routine job. They treated it like it mattered.
The world needs more people like them.
I am grateful for their quick response, their kindness, and their professionalism. I truly wish them continued growth, success, and many blessings in their business.

reviews.text:
This place is unprofessional and unsafe. I waited over five hours in extreme heat with my one year old child while the employee refused to release my vehicle or even answer the doorbell. I had valid proof of ownership and my ID was locked inside the car, which is allowed under Texas law as long as you can reasonably prove identity. She ignored me completely, walked away every time we asked for help, and refused to open the door after I told her I was filing a TDLR complaint. That shows she was retaliating and refusing service on purpose.

Multiple people tried to help me, including my partner, and she still refused and lied to the police saying people refused to show ID. That was completely false. I had my insurance, photos of my ID, and every required document. She still refused to release my vehicle. The moment my grandfather arrived she suddenly decided to help, proving she could have handled it the entire time but chose to drag it out and be petty.

Texas Occupations Code 2303 requires them to release a vehicle when ownership is reasonably verified. They cannot refuse service for personal reasons or retaliation. She violated these laws repeatedly. She also refused to identify herself, refused to provide her license information, and gave inconsistent statements to the police.

I am filing complaints with TDLR, the Texas Attorney General, the BBB, the FTC, HUD, the EEOC, and local law enforcement for retaliation, false statements, and endangering a child. My one year old could have had a heat related medical emergency because of her behavior. No business should be allowed to treat people like this.

Avoid this place. They lie, retaliate, and abuse their authority. I am following through on every single complaint.

reviews.text: I had a great experience with A&S Towing! From the moment I called, a dispatcher named Alex was professional and responsive. He gave me an accurate ETA and arrived right on time. Alex was very courteous, knowledgeable, and handled my vehicle with care, especially with my car sitting very low. He quickly assessed the situation, safely loaded my car, and even made sure I got to my destination without any hassle. The pricing was the cheapest after calling a few places nearby. He was very transparent with the price and had no surprise fees. It's rare to find a towing company that combines speed, professionalism, and genuine customer care. I highly recommend A&S Towing to anyone in need of reliable towing or roadside assistance. Thank you, Alex, for turning a stressful situation into a smooth and stress-free experience!

reviews.text: On April 21st, someone I’m close to notified me that his hauler got stuck on a hill. The hauler belongs to the company he works for. He was supposed to get off at 4:00 pm to 5:00 pm or so. However, he had to wait almost two hours for towing. Upon arrival the tow truck driver was rude and inconsiderate. Yet, the individual whom I’m close to was still polite and patient. The tow truck driver not only was rude to him but also his manager. Besides the rudeness, the main issue with the Texas Towing Inc. driver was pay. The company name was on the hauler itself. Your driver kept insisting that the individual I’m close to pay out of his pockets. However, that is the company he works for to take care of. He told the driver of Texas Towing Inc. that pay doesn’t come from him directly but the company. Despite being told the company  covers the bill, the tower consistently insisted the bill to be paid by him directly. Bad days do happen. However, the driver from Texas Towing Inc. was very insensitive and rude about the whole situation. It was like the tower was ignoring the fact that the company pays the bill on purpose. Though the individual I’m close to had numerous reasons to be disrespectful he didn’t do so. The tower was acting as if he weren’t going to get paid despite being told he will. The ignorance, insensitivity, and rudeness wasn’t needed as it already was a very long day. Due to ignoring the fact that the company covers the bill it comes off as wanting double pay. Thus, looking like a scam. I hope that tow truck drivers for Texas Towing Inc. learn how to treat human beings and actually listen.

reviews.text:
I specifically informed your driver that my vehicle had a busted radiator hose and instructed that it was not to be started under any circumstances. Despite being told this and having the keys available to place the vehicle in neutral without starting it, your driver chose to start the engine and drive it onto the tow truck.

Starting a vehicle with a known cooling system failure can cause serious engine damage, and there was absolutely no reason to take that risk after I had clearly warned your driver beforehand. My instructions were ignored, and my vehicle was unnecessarily subjected to the possibility of additional damage.

I expect an explanation as to why my explicit instructions were disregarded and what Texas Towing intends to do if any further damage was caused as a result of your employee’s actions. I trusted your company to transport my vehicle safely, not ignore the warnings I provided about its condition.
