reviews.text:
I have reached my limit with the amount of times I have to tell random strangers not to park in our one and only dock at our warehouse space we rent. The last straw was coming into open up and finding Vans and trucks parked en mass blocking access to our loading dock. I called these folks up to help as our neighbors refused to have the vehicles moved. Preferred towing sent a truck out, and got the vehicles cleared for us. They even posted their own signs, in Spanish and English, to ensure compliance so as to ensure everything is legally compliant.

I cannot begin to explain and express my gratitude to these guys for solving my parking issues with their PPI program. Now we are on day three utilizing them for parking compliance and I have no more issues to report. These guys are my heroes! I will continue to use them to keep our loading dock clear for sure! I cannot remember the tow truck operators name but that dude is one of the nicest human beings and genuinely cared about my issues. I felt as if he advocated on my behalf and gave me the voice I needed, to be heard. Thank you again for being a phenomenal company!

reviews.text:
We broke down in Dallas and called Walnut Hill Wrecker at approximately 8:00 AM. We were initially given an ETA of one hour. After an hour passed and we had not heard from a driver, we called back and were told he should arrive within the next hour.

After another hour and a half, we called again and were informed that a driver was finally en route. Around 11:00 AM, the driver arrived and was tasked with towing our vehicle just 71 miles.

Since we own a wrecker service ourselves, we rented a car and drove back to Oklahoma to retrieve one of our own tow trucks. We drove 123 miles back, returned the rental car, got a ride to our shop, picked up a truck, and headed back to meet the driver. After waiting for quite some time with no sign of him, we called for another update and were told his windshield wipers had quit working. At that point, another truck had been dispatched to complete the tow, but it was still approximately 45 minutes away.

Our vehicle was finally delivered around 5:00 PM.

What disappointed me most was not the mechanical issue itself—breakdowns happen. It was the lack of communication, the repeated inaccurate ETAs, and the fact that after an all-day ordeal there was no apology, no acknowledgment of the inconvenience, and no attempt to offer any type of discount or accommodation.

As a towing company owner, I understand that unexpected situations arise. However, if this had happened with our company, we would have sincerely apologized and worked with the customer on the bill to make things right.

Based on this experience, if you’re in a hurry or relying on accurate ETAs, you may want to consider other options.

reviews.text:
My car overheated and although I was not far from home, 16 miles, I decided to tow instead of limping as I didn't want to cause more damage.

I called, was given a good price, and was told 15 minutes for the tow truck. Roughly, two hours later the driver arrived. Customer service is seriously lacking and I believe I was lied to. When the driver arrived and I asked him about his flat tire, the reason I was given as to why he was late, he looked utterly confused.

Safety was not this drivers first concern, the use of signal lights was scarce, much like everyone else on the road these days. Being a driving instructor, and semi truck driver, this was hard to watch. Drivers that operate large vehicles should ALWAYS use signal lights.

Thankfully the guy listened to my directions on getting to my home instead of his GPS, or I'd still be in the truck. I'm also glad he heard me over the conversation he was having on his phone. It's RUDE to be on the phone when conducting business.

I paid and of course no receipt. By this point I was not expecting one.

Would I use this company again? Maybe. Would I suggest to friends? Yes with warning labels.

Single mom here. My daughter got stranded in the rain at 4 a.m. in the middle of nowhere. I was at home with a small child, feeling completely helpless, calling everywhere I could think of trying to find someone who could help. No one answered.

Finally, I called Steve. Not only did he answer, but he immediately worked to dispatch a driver, locate my daughter, and safely get her home from Dallas to Rockwall in the middle of a flash flood.

I am beyond grateful for kind, caring people like this. As a mother, you can only imagine how worried and scared I was. Tonight, The driver went above and beyond, and I’ll never forget it. He was very kind and professional, may god bless him.

My baby is finally home safe. Grounded, but safe! ❤️ Thank you again for helping when we needed it most.

I am beyond grateful for kind, caring people like this. As a mother, you can only imagine how worried and scared I was. Tonight, The driver went above and beyond, and I’ll never forget it. He was very kind and professional, may god bless him.

My baby is finally home safe. Grounded, but safe! ❤️ Thank you again for helping when we needed it most.

I called this company to fix my tire right before heading to the airport. They charged me $95 and seemed to get the job done. After being gone on vacation for a week, I came back to find the same tire completely flat again.

When I called them back, instead of helping, they gave me the runaround and kept asking the same unnecessary questions over and over, like if I had driven the car, even though I explained multiple times that I had just returned from vacation. It felt like they were trying to make it seem like I was lying.

In the end, I had to hang up and call another company to get the problem resolved. For the poor service, lack of accountability, and wasted money, I would not recommend this company.

Upon referral from Grapevine Ford, needing a tow service for a F350 crew cab dually, parked in a single bay garage, ford recommended Pro Tow for my precarious situation.  Monica at Pro Tow asked for pictures of garage, truck, driveway in order to dispatch the appropriate driver and truck.
Richard was dispatched , and after quickly assessing the degree of difficulty, he got right to work.   His level of professionalism, experience and knowledge of the tools needed, was exemplary.   Once the truck was pulled out of the garage, with minimal clearance, and safely loaded onto his tow vehicle, they were headed to Ford.  Upon arrival to Ford, Richard called and left a voicemail, letting me know my truck was in the hands of Ford!!!    This man needs a raise!!!!    He took amazing care moving this beast of a truck!

reviews.text:
This 1 star is based on pricing.
We had a freightliner stuck at an intersection, When a police officer arrived and we were forced to use the company that was fastest to get there. But being that we are stuck in the position and the officer gives us no other option, It was $1,800 for this company who was 20 minutes out to move our rig 40 foot out of the way and park it on the side of the road. $1,800… that is Highway robbery. And they know they can charge it because there’s nothing we can do about it. Again, the service was fine, but the fact that they take advantage to stick it to people who can’t say no, is not right. Our normal towing service could’ve been there in 45 minutes and haul it back to our shop which was 30 minutes away for $400 less then what they gouged us for. That is not ok.
And after talking to my tow service, he knew exactly who the company was before I told him. Meaning that this is a frequent and consistent practice of this company and what they do to people.

reviews.text: On Saturday I had a truck breakdown and requested it to be towed to South Dallas MHC. The tow truck driver took truck to Mhc in Irving because it was closer. The owner called me Tuesday morning and we discussed the situation. He stated that my driver told him to take it to the closest place. I told him that no tow company has ever not taken a truck where I've asked it to be taken to. I'd rather pay more to have it towed to a place I'm more comfortable with. He admitted that there were things that should've been handled differently so I agreed to change this from a 2 star review to a 4 star. I don't want to hurt the man's business, but make sure whatever you're having them tow goes to the place you wanted.

reviews.text:
Our family business, Family Bakery Dallas, had one of our event carts inside our cargo van when it was towed by Beard’s Towing. The cart was severely damaged while the van was in their custody, leaving us without one of our main tools for work.

What disappointed us the most was how our claim was handled. Rather than providing photographs, videos, or any evidence of the condition of the vehicle or its contents before and after the tow, our claim was denied based on assumptions, such as stating that the cart was “unsecured,” without showing any proof to support that conclusion.

We repeatedly requested a fair review and supporting evidence, but received only denial letters. The company ultimately told us to pursue legal action if we disagreed with their decision.

As a small family business, this situation has had a significant financial impact on us. We expected a more thorough investigation and greater accountability.

reviews.text:
I was in a bad way, as most of us are when we call the towing service.   We had a blowout on the fifth wheel and it took two tires out when the driver side rear tire blew. My insurance company tried three people before finding a willing candidate to come out.  The driver reached out to me by telephone and we confirmed the location, and he met me there just as I was coming back from the tire store with two new tires to put on my fifth wheel, which was broken down after a blowout.

Originally the response was a call to tow my trailer away, but that was going to take a lot of effort and much larger equipment than anyone was prepared for. So he came out with his air tools and his impact wrench, and got me rolling again.  He was kind enough to follow me back to the RV repair shop where I was gonna drop off my trailer, so that was a plus to make sure that what we did do on the side of the road was good enough to be safely rolled on its own.
I can’t say enough about the good nature and level of effort provided me when I was improvising the whole time throughout my blowout event and the plan to restore.
I would call on-call towing services again if this ever happens and I’m in that area.

reviews.text:
My son and his girlfriend went out of state across state lines to Texas from Oklahoma For a day trip for his 19th birthday. They ended up having car trouble and we were able to call JJs Towing for emergency help (After another horrible phone call to accompany where I could barely understand due to the foreign accent). JJs immediately answered, responded, and helped us when we were miles apart and was scared for my son and his safety. The driver loaded the vehicle into the truck and brought my kids, and vehicle, back when I was worried and scared beyond belief. They were honest, Kind, caring and understanding of the situation… Even though my son is technically an “adult“ he is fresh out of high school And about to go to college, just trying to enjoy his birthday on his “last summer” Before adulthood.. we are so grateful and felt like my son was in great hands with a very fair price. I constantly checked on my son throughout the entire drive, and he felt safe and comfortable as well. I would 100% recommend this company for any needs that they provide. I am a very protective mama and probably will be for the rest of my life. For them to make me feel like my child And his girlfriend were safe, makes them very reliable and trustworthy in my books, And should be in everyone else’s book as well. I am very thankful for their services. I wish I could give more stars. Please call JJs If you need trustworthy, Reliability, And feel safe. Thank you form the bottom of my heart. 🫶🏼

reviews.text:
This tow company is SO sketchy and SO sleazy for SO many reasons:

1. They towed my visitors car within 5 minutes of the permit expiring because they don’t allow for overlapping permits. So within the 5 minutes it took to park the car and go inside to get the code, the car was gone.

2. When we called to see when they picked up the car, they hung up on us. We called back and then they hung up on us AGAIN. We called under a different number and they finally started talking to us.

3. When we got there, the place looks abandoned, the lobby is empty, and the ticket window is blacked out so you can’t even see the person you are doing business with.

4. They towed the car 30 MINUTES AWAY.

5. The retrieval costs OVER $300 and when we asked for an itemized receipt, they said no. So we had to verbally get explained the breakdown of cost. Then when we paid, they asked for our ID. I’ve never been asked to show my license when using a card before EVER. And they make the cash payment cheaper for sketchy reasons iykyk

6. When getting the car, the instructions they gave were HORRIBLE - “yea just walk out that door to the right and your car will be right there” WRONG, there were 3 cars in front, none of which were the wrongfully towed car. So they have you roam this large dirt lot in THE DARK to find your vehicle.

reviews.text:
DO NOT USE!  They take advantage of you when you are stranded and can't hear.

I called for a simple dead battery and needing a jump start.  I was told $45-60 for a jump start in the middle of a bunch of legal speak.  They did say the price may go up if they have to do more work.  It is really hard to hear when you stranded in a busy area.  .  I agreed because I knew I just needed a jump start and it would be straight forward.  They then took my credit card number and forced me to commit before I had any more information .

They then told me that I would be contacted within the hour.  I thought that meant help would arrive, not get a call telling me that they had dispatched someone.

The entire process took over 2 hours and cost $170 for a 5 minute jump start.

I called to complain and they said there was $125 service call then the additional $45 for the actual start.

I cannot recommend 24 Hour Wrecker Service enough, especially their employee Cody.

I was stuck and didn’t have the extra funds to reschedule another tow, and I was genuinely worried about having to dip into my rent money just to get my car back.
Cody stepped up in a huge way and helped me out of that situation just in the nick of time. His professionalism and kindness saved me from a major financial headache. It is rare to find that kind of integrity and genuine helpfulness these days. I also have to mention the office staff! They were so kind and kept their cool while the other tow driver was being unprofessional toward them. Great people and even better service. If you need a tow, ask for Cody—he’s a lifesaver! reviews.text:
Justin W and 24HR Wrecker helped turn a very frustrating situation into something much more manageable.

I was driving through Dallas on Interstate 20 at 9PM on a Tuesday and hit a MASSIVE pothole that destroyed two of my tires and rims. I was PISSED! But as soon as Justin W arrived on the scene (MUCH faster than the tow truck I ordered - and promptly cancelled - from AAA), his friendliness and professionalism immediately diffused my frustration. The woman in the office was also incredibly helpful in finding a 24 hour tire shop and even called ahead to ensure they had parts that fit my car!

It sucks to need to have your car towed, but it sucked a LOT less thanks to Justin W and 24 HR Wrecker!

reviews.text: I had a unexpected accident in Rockwall on Sunday btwn 5-6 in the evening. Blew out 3 tires (2 passenger & 1 driver side). Had to maneuver onto the curb/sewer curb to avoid being hit by another vehicle. Truck hit curb & jumped out of control into the street and I managed to get onto the shoulder/median. Damage, airbags blown and foot railing torn off along with tires. A little shaken up, I looked up towing companies near me and Eriker Towing Services popped up with a 4.9 rating and now I know why. Erik, the owner answered professionally and got all the details. I was a little skeptical so I was hesitant when it came down to paying before service, but he offered me a fair option and it all worked out. Driver was also very careful and professional when loading and unloading the vehicle. Very satisfied 😌 to say the least. Thanks guys for ur professionalism and excellent customer service (24 hr sevice), I truly appreciate it 🙏🏽

reviews.text: I recently used Ron’s Towing service when my car battery died on Mother’s Day evening (which also happened to be a stormy Sunday). I was connected to them through my insurance roadside assistance. The lady I spoke with over the phone for the ETA was very kind and helpful. The guy who came to do the tow was both professional and friendly (especially for it being 12:30 in the morning). He took my car to the dealership and even took the time to fill out the night drop form and leave my key so I could get immediate service the next morning. This to me was above and beyond because I know he had to walk pretty far across the dealership parking lot in bad weather to get to that drop box (because the gates to the lot were closed). I even received a 1:30am phone call from the same nice lady confirming my car had successfully been dropped off. I would definitely recommend Ron’s for your towing needs!

reviews.text:
I called this company yesterday for assistance. When they arrived, my car lights were on—I had even driven my car that morning. A few hours later, the lights wouldn’t turn on, and the car wouldn’t start.

I asked them to give me a jump, and at the time of arrival, the lights were working, indicating the battery was fine. However, after Omar attempted to jump-start my car for about an hour, the lights suddenly went completely out. The owner promised to fix the issue the next day.

When I took the car to my mechanic, I was told I needed a new battery. I knew I needed an alternator, but not a new battery. According to my mechanic, the battery was damaged due to Omar overheating my car and using the wrong cables.

The owner did not keep his word and was rude, even cursing at me. I strongly advise never using this service. They were unprofessional, dishonest, and caused more damage to my vehicle

reviews.text:
Truck #27 deserves some recognition.

I witnessed the driver get put into a situation that could have gone very wrong very quickly today. Their reaction was nothing short of impressive. They stayed calm, maintained control, kept their tow secure, and handled the situation with a level of skill and professionalism you don’t see every day. The driver appeared to get cut off unexpectedly, and they managed to slow down way faster than they should have, while maintaining safety and keeping everyone on SRT out of what was a near life threatening situation.

Please give that driver the recognition they deserve. Outstanding job on this entire situation. 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻

reviews.text:
Edit after the 5/25 business response: Dear Titan Towing owner who refuses to take any accountability and tries to clear off negative reviews — if you did actually find the footage of him looking at the phone at the red light that I captured this photo at (which does not make me a distracted driver, since I wasn’t.. driving), then if you back the footage up 2 minutes you will see were he nearly ran me off the road and also him being distracted on the phone while driving the 10,000 pound wrecking machine. You think I just got bored and made this story up for some random Google review? 🤡

tl;dr: ⚠️ Extremely Dangerous and Inattentive Driving by Titan Towing

On this episode of Need for Speed: Tow Truck Edition 🏎️

Had a bit of a heart-racing encounter with a Titan Towing truck near NorthEast Mall in Fort Worth today. Picture this: I’m cruising along, following the 35 mph speed limit, and suddenly, it feels like I’m in an action movie. This massive tow truck comes zooming up behind me and swerves around my car, nearly giving my bumper a "hello" tap—definitely felt like they were pushing 55-60 mph.

At the next light, our action hero had transformed into the distracted phone user, nearly missing the green light's cue because of his phone. While I'm all for multitasking, maybe save the screen time for the coffee break? Just a thought.

All jokes aside, while the experience was more adrenaline-pumping than my daily commute calls for, I do hope Titan Towing can dial back the speed and keep their eyes on the road for safety’s sake.

reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience with A&M Towing, and I can confidently say this was one of the most professional and stress-free service experiences I’ve had. From the very first call to the final delivery of my vehicle, everything was handled with professionalism, honesty, and genuine care.

What truly sets A&M Towing apart is their communication and reliability. I was kept informed throughout the entire process, every question I had was answered promptly, and I never once felt left in the dark. In an industry where trust and timing matter, they exceeded expectations on both.

A very special shoutout to Michael, who went above and beyond to help me out. Not only was he respectful and professional, but he was also extremely reasonable with the pricing of my tow, which I truly appreciated. It’s rare to come across someone who is both fair and genuinely focused on helping customers instead of just making a quick dollar. That level of honesty and customer service speaks volumes about the company.

The driver arrived on time, handled my vehicle carefully, and made sure everything was done safely and efficiently. My vehicle arrived exactly as expected, without a single issue.

If you’re looking for a towing company that is dependable, trustworthy, fair-priced, and professional, I highly recommend A&M Towing. Michael and his team earned a loyal customer from me, and I’ll definitely be using them going forward while also recommending them to all my friends and family.

1 Star (would give 0 if I could)

KQ Towing is by far the worst towing company I have ever dealt with. When they were unloading my car, they handled it so badly that they cracked my front bumper. That’s not just sloppy work it’s flat-out negligence.

On top of that, the guys answering the phone is extremely disrespectful and unprofessional.

And if you think they’ll at least show up on time? Think again. They told me they’d be there in 30 minutes I waited over two hours before they finally arrived. They lie about their ETA, they’re unreliable, and they clearly don’t care about the stress and inconvenience they cause.

If you care at all about your car, your time, or basic respect, DO NOT USE KQ TOWING. Save yourself the headache, the damage, and the disrespect. There are plenty of towing services out there this is absolutely not the one you want touching your vehicle.

I gave them the benefit of the doubt that the call disconnected, but when I tried calling back, they ignored my call. If you want to feel like a teenager again and get ghosted, this is the company for you! This company exemplifies being in business transactionally, purely for money and without any care or regard for customers--unprofessionalism at its finest!

reviews.text:
Absolutely Reckless and Dangerous – Avoid at All Costs! Date: June 18th, 2025
Time: Approximately 2:35 PM
Location: I-30 and I-80, Dallas to Mesquite, TX

Today I witnessed one of the most dangerous and irresponsible drivers I’ve ever seen, a driver operating under AA&E Towing. The truck was weaving in and out of traffic, tailgating vehicles, cutting off cars at high speeds, and generally driving like a complete maniac. This wasn’t just careless. It was life-threatening! The driver nearly caused multiple wrecks in heavy traffic, putting countless people at risk.

I followed the truck long enough to capture clear footage on both my front and rear dash cams, showing the erratic and dangerous behavior in full. I am currently turning that footage over to the police for review and possible charges of reckless driving and endangerment.

Whoever was behind the wheel today should be fired immediately. If this was the owner of the company, then this business should be boycotted and investigated. There is no excuse for this kind of behavior on public roads, especially from a commercial towing company that is supposed to be professional and safety-conscious.

I will also be emailing the company directly, and I encourage others to come forward if they’ve experienced similar dangers. I will be updating this review with video and photo evidence soon.

AA&E Towing is a serious public safety hazard. If this company doesn’t take immediate action, they should be held legally and financially responsible for whatever tragedy their recklessness might cause in the future.

I have posted video footage where you can clearly see the truck approaching me at a dangerously high rate of speed. He came up fast and passed me within mere inches of my car, which is absolutely, 1000% reckless in a truck that size!!!! It’s a miracle he didn’t cause a collision right then and there. This footage is being turned over to the police so a formal report can be filed. I want there to be a record on file in case this company is involved in future incidents. This level of recklessness cannot go unreported. The front camera also shows the driver swerving in and out of lanes and dodging cars in an erratic, almost manic manner. It’s very possible that the driver was intoxicated, but on what, I can only imagine.

UPDATE (June 19th): Thank you to AA&E Towing for your response and for reviewing the situation and taking action. I sincerely appreciate your willingness to address this issue. If you provide a follow-up confirming what actions were taken regarding the reckless driver, I will strongly consider removing or revising this review. This issue is very personal to me, as I am disabled because of a driver just like this one. I spent seven months in the hospital and lost both of my legs due to someone’s reckless decisions behind the wheel. It deeply concerns me when I see behavior like this go unchecked. I hope this situation leads to real accountability and safer roads for everyone.

reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience with Lone Star Towing.

I parked briefly at a nearby CVS shopping center to pick up an order and was gone for less than 6 minutes before my vehicle was already being lifted onto the tow truck. The driver told me my options were to pay approximately $140 immediately or over $300 to retrieve the vehicle later from the tow yard.

The entire interaction felt aggressive and predatory. I explained my situation, including that I’m an 18-year military member traveling for Memorial Day weekend, and there was absolutely no willingness to work with me whatsoever.

What bothered me most was that the vehicle was not fully secured for transport when I approached the driver, yet I was still forced to pay a release fee on the spot. During the process, my bumper was also scraped while the vehicle was being lowered back down.

CBS News has reportedly begun looking into complaints regarding towing practices in this area, and after my experience, I can understand why. I hope this company takes a serious look at whether its towing and release practices truly reflect both ethical business standards and Texas towing regulations.

Based on my experience, this operation felt more focused on generating quick towing revenue than fairly enforcing parking policies. I would strongly encourage others to be extremely cautious parking anywhere serviced by this company.

reviews.text:
Terrible. Called and asked for a tow. They told me it might be an hour or more but they would give me a call back. I said okay and asked if it were possible to have the driver pick up the key from me at a different location nearby. I was told no and that I should just leave my key in the vehicle. I told her that the car was in a sketchy neighborhood and that I'd rather not leave the key in the car. "If you are comfortable leaving your car there, then what's the difference if the key is in it?" Just, WOW.

I stupidly went ahead with it anyway. Waited an hour and hadn't even received a call with a status update. Called back and the same lady asked me how I'm paying. She had already asked this during the first call! I told her I would pay with a card and she rudely says "well, the name of your ID needs to match the card!" I had never said anything to imply it was not my own card I was paying with -- I told her they match and she says "well okay but it will be at least an hour and a half before my next driver is available." I told her I have already been waiting in my hot car for over an hour and she says "oh wait! I might actually have another driver that could show up any minute. I'll give you a call back!" I said okay great I really appreciate it, talk soon.

I wait another 40 minutes and don't receive a call. I then decide that I'm tired of waiting in the heat and find out that I can leave my car in the parking lot overnight. I call back to tell them to cancel the tow and that I'll do it tomorrow. Someone else picked up and had none of my information on file and did not know I was even waiting!! I never received a call back from the other lady, either.

Ruined my entire day and had me waiting in the heat for no reason. Horrible, horrible experience. I wanted to cry.

reviews.text: Caution in using this provider if you’re looking for reliability and Integrety. Bowie Towing LLC was dispatched to us for roadside assistance tow. They reported that they were 29 minutes away. As time lapsed, they were 25 minutes, then 21 minutes. I received a phone call from them stating he had a pick up to complete and then would head our way in approximately 30 minutes. No problem!  Later, I received a text it would be an hour before arrival, then 41 minutes. The last text I received said 56 minutes. We felt like this may be a prank or a joke. We canceled them and called our own wrecker service. If towing company can’t make it to the tow location successfully, I can only imagine how the rest of the process would have gone.

Wouldn't recommend them.

For the price we paid I would expect them to be more experienced and skilled at what they do.

reviews.text:
So granted I'm already upset that my apartment complex had my new car towed even after I parked in the correct spot, here's how 10-4 Tow made my experience just that much worse.
I called to get the location and told them I was on my way with the cash to get my car back immediately as I was trying to be on time for work. I get there and felt in luck because I only saw one car parked, I figured I'd be next to be serviced, fast process, in and out. Well I call the tow back to let them know I'd arrived, ready to pay and she told me one person was ahead of me.. I'd be next and outta there in no time. What should have been 5-10 minutes tops turned into a 40 minute wait outside of her door in the cold..the person ahead of me didn't have her money together and the lady that knew I was ready to pay and leave allowed her to sit and call around until she got enough money. My time is as valuable as the money your company got for that free tow you got outta me. A person pulled up directly after me and was in and out because I didn't hold up the transaction by wasting anyone's time, and it would be great in the future if they'd consider not allowing people to hold up customers that are ready to pay.

reviews.text:
This company was sent to me by Allstate through my Allstate towing coverage and they were great!!  Sebastian was the driver, i got stranded about 8-830pm Wed nite.  I was quoted an ETA of 945pm-1045pm but Sebastian called me at 921 saying he was 20-30 mins away & he was a super nice guy very easy to communicate with and we discussed my vehicle breakdown and he has some mechanical knowledge so that was very helpful as well and we talked on the phone until he arrived which was only about 25 minutes after he first called.  So first I was impressed by his professionalism and his prompt arrival.  I could tell he was very experienced just by the way he handled the pick up of my vehicle.  And the ride to my apartment in his truck went totally as expected.   I've had some problems with my vehicle lately so I got scammed by a different towtruck guy last week- but my wonderful experience with Sebastian of SDR towing was totally wonderful professional and as expected.... I'm getting AAA motor club membership - but after my experience with Sebastian and SDR last night I have decided I will keep my Allstate towing coverage in addition to my AAA membership so I'll have double protection because SDR is very professional!👍👍👍

Also, as I expected,  Sebastian assured me there would be no other charges and he was correct!  My Allstate towing coverage was all i needed👍

(FYI:  many don't realize If you are stranded and have Allstate auto insurance, you'll need to verify whether you're in the "Allstate Motor Club" or just simply have  "roadside coverage on my Allstate auto policy"....apparently Allstate is working to help the public understand the difference to eliminate the confusion.  My agent himself explained all this to me last week And that helped me a lot!😉👍...... if you're confused about your Allstate roadside coverage please don't hesitate to call your agent & they'll explain it to you👍)

reviews.text: They sat out of Texas Road House and told my family we could not park down the hill in another restaurant's lot, which was empty. There were signs, saying not to park farther up, but the place we parked did not have those signs. When we exited the car, a man from LRS Towing told us we could not park in that lot. We asked where we should park, and he said "Just not in this lot". We asked if parking in the IHOP parking lot was okay, and he said "Just not in this lot". Very informative. So my family had 3 cars, we all drove over to the IHOP parking lot and walked over to the Texas Road House. Thinking that that was okay BECAUSE WE ASKED! When we were sitting, waiting for a table, we saw Texas Road House put a new sign on their front door, saying NOW don't park at the IHOP. So, we immediately went to check on the cars. The same man and a group of guys had just walked back over from our cars and they booted all 3. How is that allowed? That was not okay. WE ASKED, They said we were fine, then we got booted. Each car was $160.00 to remove the boot. The men were real pieces of work too, being rude about it. They were rude to begin with, but this was just wrong. Don't tell someone something is fine if it is not. That should be illegal. They make good money out there, LYING to people. Classy Place. ZERO STARS!

reviews.text: During rush hour last week, my SUV broke down on the freeway, and I had to call for a tow truck. I was scared, but the driver arrived there faster than I imagined and made me feel better right away. He informed me everything he was doing while loading my car and was very careful with it. He didn't simply pull the car; he also checked to make sure everything was safe before he departed. What stood out the most was how calm and professional he was the whole time. I've worked with towing companies before that appeared rushed or careless, but this time was really different. I would absolutely recommend this company to anyone who needs reliable car towing or even long-distance hauling because everything went so perfectly for me.

reviews.text: Traffic was building up behind me rapidly and my car broke down unexpectedly on the way to work and I didn't know what to do. I contacted for car towing and the answer was faster than I expected for a weekday morning. The driver was cool and arrived quickly, verified if it was only battery service first before towing, which I enjoyed because it seemed like they were not just trying to get the vehicle loaded up quickly. Unfortunately the engine would not respond so they carefully readied the automobile for towing. And all this was done step-by-step, from the placement of the flatbed to the correct securing of the wheels. I also asked about fuel supply and hauling large distances while I waited, and the driver described each in a clear manner. Dispatch communications were reliable and I always knew how far away aid was from me. The whole experience made what could have been a very stressful morning manageable.

reviews.text: Cheap towing and roadside assistance in Fort Worth TX that also happens to be fast and genuinely professional. It was August and it was 104 degrees when my car died in the parking lot of the TCU campus area on a Monday afternoon. Battery completely gone. I am a graduate student and I needed something affordable and I needed it to actually show up. Called Super Low Cost Towing because the name was honest about what I was looking for and the experience matched it. Dispatcher was straightforward, gave me a fair price before sending anyone, and the driver was there in 21 minutes. I had a great experience with Nathan from Irving Towing Service. I needed my car towed from Burleson all the way to Irving, which was about a 33-mile trip, and he handled everything professionally from start to finish.

From the beginning, Nathan was clear with the price, gave me an accurate timeline, and kept me updated throughout the whole process. He told me when he was on the way, confirmed the vehicle, sent pictures once he arrived, and made sure the car was loaded safely before leaving. That gave me a lot of peace of mind, especially because I had to go into work and could not be on my phone the whole time.

He was respectful, patient, and easy to communicate with. He also followed the drop-off instructions and delivered the car exactly where it needed to go at the dealership. The car arrived safely with no issues, and he even sent proof after it was delivered.

What I appreciated the most was that he did not make the situation stressful. Towing a car can already be frustrating, but Nathan made the whole process smooth, simple, and reliable. He was honest, fast, and professional the entire time.

I would definitely recommend Nathan and Irving Towing Service to anyone who needs a tow. Good communication, fair service, safe delivery, and a professional attitude. I will definitely call him again if I ever need towing service in the future.

reviews.text:
I wanted to take a moment to sincerely thank everyone at AA Wrecker Service.

Last Sunday, my car was impounded, and I’ll be honest, I went in expecting the worst. Places like these don’t always have the best reputation, but from the very first visit, your staff completely proved me wrong. When I came in just to collect my belongings, everyone was respectful, patient, and genuinely kind, and that immediately stood out to me.

My car ended up being there for a full week, and when it was finally time to get it out, the cost was higher than what i had presumed it to be. (I didn’t have enough money to get it out) There were 3 tow truck drivers/ Associates i want to specifically acknowledge who went to bat for me that day. What stood out just as much as the gesture itself was their humility afterwards. When I tried to get their names so I could thank them individually, they brushed it off and emphasized that the credit belonged to the entire team, not to them personally. That kind of selflessness and team-oriented integrity is rare and speaks volumes about the culture at AA Wrecker Service. Your team treated me with professionalism and understanding, and most importantly with respect.

On top of that, after everything was paid and handled, my car wouldn’t start. Instead of sending me on my way, your staff helped jump my car and made sure I was good to go. That extra effort was not only greatly appreciated but restored my faith in corporate companies who put customer care above profits.

Reading your reviews afterward, I realized how consistent this experience is, and I’m glad to now be adding my voice to that.

I want to thank Jack and his team down at AA Wrecker from the bottom of my heart, for not only changing my perspective but also treating people with dignity during a stressful time. I’m truly grateful and won’t forget this experience.

Best Regards

The Green Family

reviews.text:
In my experience, the gentleman that came to tow my Harley Davidson damaged my Harley’s front fender. Decent scratches & deep.
Used a tow strap to pull it, and did not use towels during the loading process but only after the damage was noticed once on the bed, he lightened the pull strap and then tried to hide the damage done with a towel.
I had already noticed it.
So did he. He admitted to it and said please don’t tell my boss. He offered his number and contact information. Which I reached out to him on after I heard from my professional painter what it was going to cost to repair the damage. My paint job is custom mind you. He then during that conversation told me he got fired.
Regardless this tow company damaged my vehicle and I would not recommend anyone use this company unless all of the others in town go out of business.
I reached out to the company and filed/losged a complaint against the gentleman and wanted to speak with the owner. I was told the owner would reach back out to me. This was now 2 days ago. And crickets. Nothing. So I’m posting this. I was going to hold off writing a review as I don’t usually. But this company, the people need to be aware of.
Please be weary.  The images were taken while the bikes was still on the tow truck.

reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Texas Towing and Hauling LLC and cannot recommend them highly enough. I needed my severely damaged vehicle following a major accident picked up from another towing company that was charging nearly double simply to return it to my home. From the moment I contacted Texas Towing and Hauling, their dispatcher responded immediately and handled my situation with professionalism and urgency. They arranged a tow within an hour, which was incredibly impressive.

The driver was courteous and went above and beyond by allowing me to ride back with him to my home. When we encountered an issue with the car not starting, he took extra time to troubleshoot and ensure I was not left stranded. He stayed until we confirmed the issue was simply a dead battery that needed charging. His patience and genuine concern made a stressful situation much easier to manage.

I truly appreciate the efficiency, care, and reasonable pricing this company offers. Texas Towing and Hauling LLC provides outstanding service, and I would confidently recommend them to anyone in need of reliable towing support.

reviews.text:
My vehicle was parked in the parking lot on private property. I was parked adjacent to a marked fire lane (not tow away zone) but had received permission from management to park my truck and trailer there while I awaited for the parking lot to clear. I went upstairs to my room to deposit my things and wait for the parking lot to clear of obstruction so I could park elsewhere. During that time, a tow was initiated by the tow truck driver, not at the request of the hotel, which granted me permission and not at the request of any city official police department or fire department. After contacting the tow truck service, the dispatcher was very rude and hung up several times. Subsequent phone calls were not answered from multiple individuals, including hotel management, and law-enforcement. We then went to the location of the impound facility, which is clearly marked Vehicle Storage Facility. Signage required to by law posted clearly stated vehicles release 24 hours a day with one hour notice. However, we could get nobody to answer the phone or respond to the location.

I have several concerns with this incident, the first of which is the obviously illegal, towing and impoundment of the vehicle trailer and tractor carried on it. Concern number two is the fact that they will not answer the phone nor respond to the facility as required of a VSF of their nature. Concern number three Is the absolute lack of professional, courtesy, exhibited by the staff that answers the phone or in this case refuses to answer the phone after the first call.

I have already filed a complaint electronically with the TDLR regarding the tow truck facility and the permitted VSF and will be contacting in person today. Businesses like this, that operate outside the normal bounds of professional conduct, or the codes : laws and regulations that mandate how they should be run cannot be tolerated. Businesses like this, give all the rest of similar nature, bad names. There is no telling how many times this company has illegally towed vehicles, and collected fees that they were not lawfully, entitled to.

I have every intention of falling this complaint through both civilly and criminally And holding these individuals accountable on all levels.

reviews.text:
DO NO USE THESE PEOPLE

I initially called for a tow and was quoted a price nearly $100 cheaper than what I was ultimately charged. The representative instructed me to send my vehicle’s information via text to a random number. After sending the details, I waited about ten minutes without any response before calling back to ask about the payment details. At that point, the same representative informed me that the price had increased.

Since I was stranded near my job during my lunch break and had been promised a 30-minute wait time, I reluctantly agreed. When I gave them my credit card information, I was also told that if I canceled now, I would still be charged half the amount. With no other options, I proceeded.

After 30 minutes, no one arrived. I waited another 30 minutes, but it wasn’t until an hour after that original call that I finally received a call from the tow company, telling me it would still be another hour before they could arrive due to traffic. By that time, my car had started, so I no longer needed the tow. In total, it took them nearly two hours after my initial call to even contact me about the estimated time of arrival.

The driver informed the company that I no longer needed the service, but I noticed they still charged the full amount to my card. When I called to report the mistake, I was assured they would correct it. It’s now been over a month, and I still haven’t received my refund.

I strongly advise others to avoid this company—they are unreliable and dishonest.

reviews.text: Power steering pump failed on me on I-30 westbound near the Hulen Street exit heading into the Cultural District area on a Tuesday afternoon. Wheel went heavy instantly and I had maybe a half mile of controlled coasting before I got it to the right shoulder. Called Town's Corner Towing Assistance and the dispatcher had my location confirmed and a driver heading out before I finished the description. She gave me a 33 minute ETA and told me to stay buckled and not attempt to steer it further. Driver came in 31, had his safety gear set before approaching my car, loaded the flatbed efficiently given the shoulder situation, and drove me to a shop on South University Drive I had used before. From call to shop in under 90 minutes on I-30 westbound in afternoon traffic. That is the only outcome I needed.

reviews.text: I am going to be specific because I think it is more useful than a general positive review. My car died near the Fairmount neighborhood on a Wednesday afternoon. I called two companies before Town's Corner. First did not answer. Second gave me a vague two-hour window and went quiet afterward. Town's Corner answered immediately, gave me a 34 minute window, driver arrived in 32. He assessed the car before touching anything, explained what he was planning to do, loaded it cleanly, and the price at the shop matched the quote on the phone to the dollar. Four things that should be standard and are not always. I have been driving in Tarrant County long enough to know when a towing company actually has its operation together. This one does.

reviews.text: My son is a junior at TCU and his car would not start in a parking lot near the campus after an evening class. He called me before he called a tow company because he did not know which one to use. I found Town's Corner Towing Assistance, called them while he waited with the car. Dispatcher was calm and patient and was not thrown by me calling on his behalf from across town. Driver showed up in about 30 minutes, tried a jump, it held, and he stayed with my son for a few minutes to confirm the car was not going to die again before driving away. My son texted me saying the driver was solid and explained what had happened with the battery. For a college kid who had never dealt with a car situation alone before, that steady presence and explanation mattered. Really appreciated how Town's Corner handled it.

reviews.text: Fuel pump gave out on me on I-35W northbound near the North Side Drive exit during Thursday evening rush. No warning, no gradual decline, just complete loss of power. I had enough roll to get the car to the shoulder before the merge traffic closed in and sat there watching the city move around me at full speed. Called Specialists Towing and the dispatcher was steady and specific. Got my location confirmed, gave me a 34 minute ETA, and told me in plain terms to stay buckled with the door closed until the driver was directly behind me with his lights going. He came in 32. Set up his safety equipment before doing anything else, loaded the flatbed efficiently, and drove me to a shop on North Main Street that could look at it the next morning. That I-35W shoulder near North Side is tight and he worked it without hesitation. Really glad I found these guys.
